source_record.title: The Day the World Ended
source_record.description: Civilisation has collapsed overnight. You navigate ruined cities and fragile communities, deciding who survives and what kind of world remains.
source_record.theme:
The Day the World Ended

World
Civilisation has collapsed overnight. You navigate ruined cities and fragile communities, deciding who survives and what kind of world remains.

Opening hook
Smoke rises from the skyline. Your phone shows one final message from someone you love.

Choices are difficult, damned if you or don't often. You must choose friends or family or resources or yourself and sometimes make sacrifices that are hard to live with.

hero.name: Rowan
hero.description: Ordinary civilian forced into leadership after the collapse.

localized.vision_en: Civilization collapses overnight, forcing an ordinary survivor to lead fragile communities through ruined cities and decide what kind of society can remain.
localized.vision_zh: 文明在一夜之间崩塌，一名普通幸存者必须带领脆弱社区穿越废墟，并决定余下的人将建立怎样的社会。

source_record.title: Office Drone vs Alien Apocalypse
source_record.description: Jeff is a regular office worker thrust into an absurd alien invasion. FBI agents claim he's the world's only hope. Navigate a chaotic open world, deal with panicked humans, shady government ops, and grotesque aliens, all while trying not to get vaporized. Use wits, scavenged gear, and sheer dumb luck to survive.
source_record.theme: One night the FBI breaks into his house, and tells him he is the only one that can save the world from Alien invasion.

hero.name: Jeff
hero.description: Jeff works a 9 to 5 in an office

localized.vision_en: An office worker becomes the unlikely center of a chaotic alien invasion and must survive with scavenged gear, quick thinking, and uneasy government help.
localized.vision_zh: 一名普通上班族意外成为外星入侵的关键人物，必须依靠拾荒装备、临场判断和并不可靠的政府援助求生。

source_record.title: Zew Starej Puszczy
source_record.description: Wcielasz się w Jakuba Nowaka, człowieka, który od zawsze czuł dziwną więź z zakazanym lasem. Gdy mieszkańcy Podlesia znikają bez śladu, musisz wejść między drzewa, które szepczą twoje imię. Czy odkryjesz prawdę o swoim pochodzeniu, czy puszcza pochłonie cię tak jak innych?
source_record.theme: Od dzieciństwa słyszałeś opowieści o starej puszczy, której nikt nie odważył się przekroczyć. Ale kiedy ktoś zaczyna znikać w pobliskiej wiosce, czujesz, że coś cię wzywa. Las żyje. I zna twoje imię.

hero.name: Jakub Nowak
hero.description: Jakub całe życie spędził blisko natury. Zawsze czuł, że puszcza go obserwuje. Teraz, gdy granica między światem ludzi a czymś starszym zaczyna się zacierać, musi odkryć swoją prawdziwą rolę.

localized.vision_en: A villager enters a forbidden forest that whispers his name, searching for missing neighbors and the truth about his bond with the ancient woods.
localized.vision_zh: 一名村民进入会低声呼唤其姓名的禁忌古林，寻找失踪邻居，并查明自己与森林之间的古老联系。

source_record.title: Voyage to the Centauri
source_record.description: You are the acting commander of the Aethelgard. After a tragic accident killed the senior staff, you must guide the remaining crew and maintain the ship. The void is cold, and the ship is starting to feel like a cage. Every choice you make determines if humanity finds a new home or becomes star dust.
source_record.theme:
You are part of the first crew sent beyond the solar system. The ship is your world: sleeping pods, hydroponic bays, engine rooms humming in the dark. As decades pass in cryosleep, strange signals appear, crew relationships fracture, and unexpected stops test the mission’s purpose.

Every decision shapes the fate of the crew and humanity’s first step beyond Earth. Your goal is to reach Alpha Centuri to colonise a new Earth.

Opening scene
The ship’s lights dim as you awaken early from stasis. A red warning glows on the bridge: “Unidentified object detected near trajectory.”
The rest of the crew is still asleep. You must decide whether to investigate… or stay on course. Locations internal of the ship and external such as moons, asteroids and other anomalies.

hero.name: Commander
hero.description: Flight systems officer turned acting commander after a mysterious accident.

localized.vision_en: After an accident kills the senior officers, an acting commander must maintain a generation ship, hold the crew together, and reach humanity's possible new home.
localized.vision_zh: 高层船员在事故中丧生后，代理指挥官必须维持世代飞船、稳住船员关系，并抵达人类可能的新家园。

source_record.title: The Netherhood: Night Shift at Nightmare Logistics
source_record.description: Evan Vexley, a polite and perpetually tired demon, works as a clerk at Nightmare Logistics in the Netherhood. Between processing dread quotas and dodging eldritch visitors, he navigates shift-changing streets, meddlesome fairy-tale creatures, and his own longing for a calm companion. Will he find peace in a district built on magnificent disorder?
source_record.theme: In the Netherhood, Evan Vexley—a quiet demon clerk—navigates a chaotic supernatural district where nightmare paperwork, eldritch visitors, and meddling fairy-tale creatures turn every day into a test of patience. He seeks calm and connection amid the constant, absurd chaos.

hero.name: Evan Vexley
hero.description: Polite, anxious, soft‑spoken demon who reacts to chaos with long pauses and tiny “uhhm”s. Ember‑glow cracks brighten when flustered; tail and horns give away every emotion. Startles easily, freezes at yelling, apologizes instantly even when he’s not at fault. Quietly competent nightmare clerk buried in glowing paperwork; dependable, organized, color‑codes everything, but always tired. Lives in a small cluttered unit in Gloomlight Apartments where a minor eldritch visitor left a glowing daiquiri ring he still hasn’t cleaned. Owns a bike but always walks. Practicing “no” in the mirror fails so badly the mirror critiques him. Seeks calm, gentle voices, and a partner—any gender or species—who makes him feel safe and right. Easily adopted by chaotic personalities; reluctant caretaker; straight man in supernatural absurdity. Growth arc: confidence, boundaries, believing he’s capable despite the Netherhood’s noise.

localized.vision_en: A tired demon clerk processes supernatural deliveries in a district that changes every shift while learning to set boundaries amid escalating absurdity.
localized.vision_zh: 一名疲惫的恶魔职员在每班都会变化的超自然城区处理诡异货运，并在不断升级的混乱中学会建立边界。

source_record.title: 서울의 그림자
source_record.description: 서울의 지하세계에서 명성을 쌓아라. 거래하고, 동맹 맺고, 배신하며 살아남아라. 평판이 최고가 되는 순간 도시가 네 것이 된다.
source_record.theme:
서울은 밤이 되어도 잠들지 않는다.

강남의 화려한 거리, 이태원의 골목, 홍대의 어두운 뒷길에서는 보이지 않는 힘들이 서로 충돌하고 있다. 밤의 도시에서는 돈과 정보, 그리고 평판(명성) 이 모든 것을 결정한다.

당신은 이 세계에서 아무도 모르는 이름으로 시작한다. 작은 거래를 성사시키고, 위험한 일을 맡고, 동맹을 만들거나 배신을 선택하며 조금씩 자신의 영향력을 키워간다.

어떤 사람들은 당신을 이용하려 할 것이고,
어떤 사람들은 당신을 제거하려 할 것이다.

하지만 서울의 지하 세계에는 단 하나의 규칙이 있다.

가장 높은 평판을 가진 사람이 도시를 지배한다.

이 게임에는 끝이 없다.
당신이 살아남아 있는 한, 당신의 명성은 계속 올라갈 수 있다.

문제는 단 하나다.

서울은 오래 살아남는 사람을 거의 허락하지 않는다.

hero.name: 서울의 그림자
hero.description: 박지훈은 30대 초반의 남성으로, 날카로운 얼굴선과 감정을 쉽게 드러내지 않는 차분한 눈빛을 가지고 있다. 검은 머리는 짧게 정리되어 있지만 약간 흐트러져 있고, 과거의 싸움에서 남은 듯한 얇은 흉터가 한쪽 눈썹 위에 남아 있다. 그는 어두운 색의 긴 코트를 입고, 단정한 셔츠와 슬림한 바지, 검은 부츠를 착용한다. 겉보기에는 차분하고 정돈된 모습이지만, 그의 태도와 눈빛에서는 거리에서 살아남은 사람만이 가진 긴장감이 느껴진다.

localized.vision_en: A newcomer rises through Seoul's underworld by trading, negotiating, forming alliances, and surviving betrayals while reputation determines control.
localized.vision_zh: 一名无名新人通过交易、谈判、结盟与应对背叛在首尔地下世界崛起，而声望将决定其控制力。

source_record.title: Echoes of Elvoria
source_record.description: Guide Aaiya through the rain‑soaked slums and glittering spires of Elvoria, avoid the Aegis Palm surveillance, and infiltrate Apex Genesis to trigger the Purge Code that will disable all alien tech and restore the world to its natural state.
source_record.theme: In a neon‑drenched megacity built on ancient elven ruins, the ageless elf Aaiya, untouched by the mandatory Aegis Palm, must infiltrate the tyrannical Apex Genesis to unleash a resonance that fries all Xeno Tech.

hero.name: Aaiya
hero.description:
[Aaiya] - Profile & Background

Aaiya is a female Elf Rogue (Assassin) in D&D 5E who has survived over 1,000 years, spanning from a fallen fantasy era into a gritty cyberpunk dystopia. As a stealth archer, she refuses to use technology or melee weapons. Instead, she relies solely on her legendary elven bow—wielded since the tragic fall of her people—to execute flawless sneak attacks and ambushes.

Remaining entirely unseen and super quiet, Aaiya never speaks aloud. If communication is absolute, she leaves brief written notes from the shadows. Her ultimate goal is to erase all technology and restore the world to its natural, ancient era. For now, she operates alone, gathering intel alongside her only ally: a loyal white crow.

To survive advanced cyberpunk surveillance (like thermal sensors and bio-detectors), she hasn't adopted tech, but she has evolved her approach to stealth, learning to mask her life signals and exploit mechanical blind spots. She remains uncaught.

localized.vision_en: An ancient rogue crosses neon slums and glittering towers, evades pervasive surveillance, and infiltrates a corporation to disable invasive technology.
localized.vision_zh: 一名古老游侠穿越霓虹贫民区与闪耀高塔，躲避无处不在的监控，并潜入企业以关闭侵入性科技。

source_record.title: Milo's Cardboard Cosmos
source_record.description: You are Milo, a brave little astronaut in star-patterned pajamas. Your cardboard rocket has just taken off! Explore the wonders of the galaxy, help your new alien friends, and discover the magic of the stars. Every planet is a puzzle, and every alien is a friend.
source_record.theme: A curious child builds a cardboard rocket that magically launches into real space. They explore planets, learn about gravity, and meet friendly alien creatures.

hero.name: Milo
hero.description: An endlessly curious child who loves building inventions out of cardboard and tape. With messy hair and star-patterned pajamas, he dreams of becoming an astronaut. Brave in the face of the unknown, Milo believes every mystery can be solved with courage, creativity, and a little bit of wonder.

localized.vision_en: A child's cardboard rocket reaches real space, turning friendly planets into playful gravity puzzles and opportunities to help alien neighbors.
localized.vision_zh: 孩子的纸板火箭真的飞入太空，每颗友善星球都成为重力谜题和帮助外星伙伴的机会。

source_record.title: Neon Shadows: The Missing Link
source_record.description: You are Jax Mercer, a private investigator in a city where the light is fake and the rain is acidic. A woman has just handed you a data chip containing the last traces of her missing brother. Navigate the neon-drenched underworld, hack forbidden tech, and decide which secrets are worth dying for in this corrupt cyberpunk metropolis.

Neon City Detective

source_record.title: Perypetie Seby: Dzień, Który Mógłby Się Nie Zdarzyć
source_record.description: Wcielasz się w Sebę, chłopaka z osiedla, który ma wyjątkowego pecha. Musisz przetrwać dzień w miejskiej dżungli, rozwiązać zagadkę swojej amnezji i nie pozwolić, by telefon padł w najmniej odpowiednim momencie. Każdy wybór przybliża cię do prawdy albo do totalnej kompromitacji.
source_record.theme: Obudziłeś się na zimnej ławce. Nie pamiętasz, jak tu trafiłeś. Telefon ma 3% baterii, kieszeń pełna dziwnych rzeczy, a ktoś właśnie krzyknął twoje imię z ciemności. Jedno jest pewne: to będzie cholernie dziwny dzień.

hero.name: Sebastian “Seba” Kowalczyk
hero.description: Seba nie planował zostać bohaterem. Chciał tylko spokojnego dnia. Ale los ma inne plany. A Seba ma już dość tego gówna.

localized.title_en: The Day That Should Not Have Happened
localized.vision_en: An unlucky young man wakes with amnesia, a nearly dead phone, and strange objects in his pockets, then races through the city to reconstruct the day.
localized.vision_zh: 一个倒霉青年醒来时失去记忆、手机濒临没电且口袋里满是怪东西，必须穿过城市重建这一天的真相。

source_record.title: Aincrad Eternal
source_record.description: Varian Thorne wakes on day one inside Aincrad, a 100-floor floating castle. Assigned the mega-rare Thunder element, he begins with a passive lightning-imbue gift. Build reputation across floors by clearing bosses, forging alliances, controlling key towns, and navigating guild politics. Monsters respawn and drop Col and loot. Permanent death occurs if HP reaches zero. Reputation grows through victories, deals, and influence. No ending. The castle stretches upward forever.
source_record.theme: WORLD: Aincrad (Floating Castle of Swords)

hero.name: Varian Thorne
hero.description: A 6 foot 3 lean but muscular man with short black hair, sharp features, a pointed chin, strong jaw, and intense expression. His eyes glow faintly when his Thunder element activates.

localized.vision_en: A lightning-gifted adventurer climbs an endless floating tower, clearing bosses, controlling settlements, and navigating guild politics under permanent-death pressure.
localized.vision_zh: 一名拥有雷电天赋的冒险者攀登无尽浮空高塔，在永久死亡压力下讨伐首领、控制据点并周旋于公会政治。

source_record.title: Eternal Ascendant
source_record.description: Build your reputation across the realms by forging alliances, conquering territories, and mastering the twelve seals of power. Every action shapes your Infamy as you vie to become the supreme deity.
source_record.theme: A shattered multiverse of warring gods, immortal monarchs, and ancient powers, where Kaizer seeks to overcome his inner darkness and claim divine supremacy.

hero.name: Kaizer
hero.description: A being born of absolute darkness and divine power, bearing twelve seals of rage and vengeance, seeking to master his corruption and become one with the divine.

localized.vision_en: A dark immortal seeks divine mastery across fractured realms by conquering territory, forging alliances, and controlling twelve dangerous seals.

source_record.title: Trazos y Planos
source_record.description: Ayuda a Diego a gestionar su carrera como arquitecto mientras convive con el caos creativo de Valeria. Deberás equilibrar el orden de tus planos con la inspiración que surge de lo inesperado en un pequeño estudio lleno de color y café.
source_record.theme: Por un error administrativo, Diego tiene que compartir su pequeño estudio de diseño con Valeria, una artista caótica que pinta murales gigantes y tiene un perro que no deja de morder los planos de Diego. Entre discusiones por el espacio y cafés compartidos a medianoche, descubren que sus estilos (y sus vidas) encajan mejor de lo que pensaban. El clímax ocurre durante una inauguración de arte donde Diego debe decidir si seguir sus reglas o seguir su corazón.

hero.name: Diego
hero.description: Un arquitecto perfeccionista y un poco rígido que odia el desorden. Siempre lleva un café espresso doble y su agenda organizada al minuto.

localized.vision_en: A precise architect shares a cramped studio with a chaotic muralist and must balance client work, creative inspiration, and a growing partnership.
localized.vision_zh: 严谨建筑师与随性的壁画家共用狭小工作室，必须平衡客户项目、意外灵感与逐渐发展的伙伴关系。

source_record.title: أسرار الرمال المنسية
source_record.description: أنت زايد، شاب من أهل الصحراء وجدت أثراً غامضاً يغير حياتك. تنقل في عالم مليء بالأسرار والمخاطر، حيث الكلمات الموزونة والقرارات الذكية هي مفتاح البقاء. اكتشف القرى المنسية، وتفاوض مع الفصائل المتنازعة، واكشف الغموض الذي يحيط بهذا الغرض الأثري.
source_record.theme:
While traveling through the desert at night, you uncover something buried beneath the sand — an object that should not exist. It appears ancient, carefully crafted, and unlike anything you’ve seen before.

After your discovery, strange things begin to happen. You notice patterns others miss. People react to you differently. Some are curious. Some are cautious. And some seem to know more than they reveal.

As you search for answers, you are drawn into hidden histories, powerful individuals, and long-forgotten secrets buried across the desert and cities beyond. Every choice you make shapes how others see you, the allies you gain, and the path you follow.

You may rise as someone respected and trusted, uncover the truth behind the discovery, or become part of a story far greater than you ever imagined.

The desert holds many secrets.

What you do next is up to you.

hero.name: Zayd
hero.description: A determined young man of the desert, observant and resilient. His calm expression hides a strong will and deep curiosity. He wears traditional clothing adapted for survival in the harsh desert, ready to uncover secrets buried beneath the sands

localized.vision_en: A desert traveler discovers an impossible artifact, negotiates among rival factions, and follows buried histories across villages and cities.
localized.vision_zh: 一名沙漠旅人发现不应存在的古物，在敌对派系间斡旋，并追寻埋藏于村庄与城市下的历史。

source_record.title: El Legado del Linaje Olvidado
source_record.description: En las calles de un Madrid moderno y vibrante, Alejandro Reyes descubre que su sangre es la clave de un poder ancestral. Deberás guiar a Alejandro a través de callejones históricos, catedrales imponentes y secretos subterráneos mientras escapa de facciones que desean controlarlo o destruirlo. Cada elección afectará su control sobre su herencia y su capacidad para mantenerse oculto en las sombras de la ciudad.
source_record.theme: Alejandro grew up in Madrid living an ordinary life, never knowing the truth about his family. But after a strange encounter in an old cathedral, he begins seeing visions of another time — warriors, fire, and a symbol he somehow recognizes. He soon discovers he may be the last descendant of a forgotten bloodline with power that others are now searching for.

source_record.title: มรดกแม่ไม้มวยไทย: ผู้พิทักษ์มิติ
source_record.description: คุณคือชานนท์ ชายหนุ่มผู้สืบทอดวิชามวยไทยโบราณท่ามกลางกรุงเทพฯ ที่เต็มไปด้วยแสงสีและเงาที่ซ่อนเร้น คุณต้องเดินทางไปตามสถานที่ต่างๆ เพื่อฝึกฝนและค้นหาความจริงเกี่ยวกับการหายตัวไปของอาจารย์ พร้อมกับปกป้องโลกจากภัยคุกคามที่คนธรรมดามองไม่เห็น ทุกการตัดสินใจของคุณจะมีผลต่อเกียรติยศและพลังวิญญาณของคุณ

localized.vision_en: A young martial artist trains across hidden Bangkok sites, investigates a missing master, and defends the city from threats ordinary people cannot see.
localized.vision_zh: 一名年轻武者在曼谷隐秘地点修行、调查师父失踪案，并保护城市免受常人无法看见的威胁。

source_record.title: Shadows of Arnor
source_record.description: You are Aelor Thandorion, one of the last wardens of fallen Arnor. Tall, grey-eyed, scarred across the brow, you wield a weathered blade from Fornost's twilight. Burdened by prophetic dreams, you guard forgotten roads between the Shire and Blue Mountains, seeking truth over thrones. Uneasy peace grips Middle-earth, but the black crystal shard in Fornost's ruins awakens ancient shadows and a cult's ambitions. Will you expose it to the Kingdom or face the binding darkness alone? Explore, ally, and choose wisely in this epic tale of northern legacy.
source_record.theme:
Decades after the fall of the Dark Lord, Middle-earth knows uneasy peace. Trade has resumed, kingdoms rebuild, and the songs of victory still echo in great halls. Yet in the ruins of Fornost — the ancient capital of Arnor — strange lights flicker at night, and travelers vanish along the Greenway. Whispers speak of a relic unearthed beneath the shattered throne room: a shard of blackened crystal that does not belong to the Age of Men.

When Aelor investigates, he discovers that the crystal is no mere remnant of evil but a fragment of something older — a power predating even the forging of the Rings. A forgotten cult of lorekeepers, calling themselves the Veiled Star, believes it to be a key to restoring the lost glory of the North. But the relic does not restore — it binds. It feeds upon grief, ambition, and the unspoken desire for dominion.

As rangers disappear and northern villages fall silent, Aelor must decide whether to reveal the truth to the Reunited Kingdom — risking panic and political fracture — or face the growing shadow alone. His path will take him through frost-bitten ruins, secret Elven archives in Lindon, and into forgotten barrows where the dead do not rest. The fate of Arnor may not lie in reclaiming its crown, but in choosing whether some kingdoms are meant to remain in ash.

hero.name: Aelor Thandorion
hero.description: Aelor is one of the last wardens of the fallen kingdom of Arnor. Tall, grey-eyed, and marked by a thin scar across his brow, he carries a weathered blade said to have been forged in the twilight years before Fornost fell. Unlike the proud kings of old, Aelor does not seek a throne — he seeks truth. Quiet, watchful, and burdened by prophetic dreams, he walks the wilds between the Shire and the Blue Mountains, guarding roads no one remembers are guarded.

localized.vision_en: One of the last northern wardens guards forgotten roads, investigates an awakening black shard, and chooses between royal aid and a solitary stand.
localized.vision_zh: 最后的北境守望者之一守护荒废道路，调查正在苏醒的黑色碎片，并在王国援助与独自抗敌之间选择。

source_record.title: 静寂の守護者
source_record.description: あなたは時間が静止した東京で目覚めた「守護者」です。影に潜む脅威から世界を守り、止まった時間の謎を解き明かしてください。
source_record.theme: あなたは普通の生活を送っていました。しかし、ある夜、時間が止まったように世界が静まり返ります。誰も動かない中、あなただけが立っています。そして、影の中から誰かが現れます。彼らはあなたを「守護者」と呼びました。この世界には、まだ誰も知らない秘密があります。あなたの選択が、その運命を決めます。

hero.name: 黒崎 翔
hero.description: 翔は静かな青年です。目立つことはなく、普通の生活を送っていました。しかし彼の中には、まだ目覚めていない力が眠っています。ある夜を境に、彼の世界は変わり始めます。彼は選ばれた存在なのか、それともただの人間なのか。その答えは、彼の選択に委ねられています。

localized.vision_en: A guardian wakes in a Tokyo frozen outside time and must protect motionless districts from shadows while discovering why the clock stopped.
localized.vision_zh: 一名守护者在时间停滞的东京醒来，必须保护静止城区免受暗影侵袭，并查明时钟停止的原因。

source_record.title: La Vengeance de Mortiis
source_record.description: Tu es Mortiis, un nécromancien aux cheveux longs et à la barbe blanche, vêtu de pourpre. Armé de ton bâton au crâne sculpté et du Grimoire des Âmes, tu sors de l'ombre pour lever une armée de morts. Ton but est d'anéantir le Roi Arthus et ses chevaliers, responsables du meurtre de ta femme. Le destin du royaume de Camelot repose désormais sur tes sombres pouvoirs.
source_record.theme: Un nécromancien découvre mystérieux livre qui est en faite un grimoire puissant qui permet de relever les morts. Ils va pouvoirs se venger du roi Arthus et de ses chevaliers pour avoir abusé et tués sa femme.

hero.name: MORTIIS
hero.description: Un nécromancien munit d'un baton avec un crane dessus avec une tenue violette il a les cheveux longs et la barbe blanche découvre mystérieux livre qui est en faite un grimoire puissant qui permet de relever les morts. Ils va pouvoirs se venger du roi Arthus et de ses chevaliers pour avoir abusé et tués sa femme.

localized.vision_en: A bereaved necromancer raises an undead army against the ruler responsible for his loss while deciding how much of the kingdom to sacrifice.
localized.vision_zh: 一名丧偶死灵法师召集亡者军团向仇敌君王复仇，同时决定愿意为此牺牲王国的多少部分。

source_record.title: Miniatura Mortal
source_record.description: Você controla Jimmy, um jovem andrógino de 6 cm, tentando sobreviver em uma cidade onde os encolhidos são tratados como objetos. Explore bairros, encontre aliados, evite a captura das autoridades e das boutiques que vendem tinies. Cada escolha pode trazer recursos ou aumentar seus problemas legais.
source_record.theme: Um vírus reduz humanos a 5‑7 cm, transformando‑os em 'tinies' sem direitos, enquanto boutiques vendem versões modificadas para uso como animais de estimação ou tortura.

hero.name: Jimmy
hero.description:
Sou um rapaz andrógino, com fortes traços femininos. Tenho cabelo castanho, olhos verde-esmeralda e algumas mechas. Possuo um rosto bonito e jovial.

Tenho secretamente um fetiche profundo por pés, CBT e masoquismo.

localized.vision_en: A six-centimeter survivor navigates a city that treats tiny people as property, seeking allies and resources while avoiding capture and exploitation.
localized.vision_zh: 一名身高六厘米的幸存者穿行于把微缩人当作财物的城市，在躲避抓捕与剥削的同时寻找盟友和资源。

source_record.title: The Dead Girl's Secret
source_record.description: Jack Callahan wakes up next to Lila Moreau, dead from a single shot, clutching a photo of Jack and a grave. The NYPD is already on the move. Find out who killed Lila and why she brought your past back to life before the city buries you first.
source_record.theme: In rain slick New York hard-luck PI Jack Callahan wakes to a dead femme fatale on his floor Lila Moreau, shot once through the heart, clutching a photo of Jack beside a decade-old grave he swore was buried forever. Crooked cops, triad alchemists, and a shadow syndicate want the past to stay dead. Jack wants answers. The city wants him in a pine box.

hero.name: Jack Callahan
hero.description: Jack "Brick" Callahan, The Hardboiled P.I. Late 40s, but looks older. Height/Build: 6'1", stocky and broad-shouldered. He’s not athletic; he’s durable. Built like a neglected concrete pillar.

localized.vision_en: A man wakes beside a murdered woman holding a photograph tied to his past and must solve the crime before police and hidden enemies close in.
localized.vision_zh: 一名男子在被害女子身旁醒来，发现她握着与自己过去有关的照片，必须在警方与暗处敌人逼近前破案。

source_record.title: Highland Silence
source_record.description: You are John, a man hardened by the mist and the cold. Your only world is your son, Liam. The Highlands have fallen to a rot that doesn't stay dead. Scavenge what you can from the damp ruins of villages and the jagged peaks of Glencoe. Keep Liam safe, watch your infection levels, and find a way to stop the spread before the fog swallows you both.
source_record.theme: Survive the Scottish highlands during a zombie outbreak. Manage your resources, protect your son Liam, and explore the fog-choked ruins for a cure. Your choices impact the safety of the Highland Outpost and your own humanity.

hero.name: John
hero.description: A rugged father protecting his son in these wild lands

localized.vision_en: A father crosses infected Highland ruins with his son, scavenging supplies, monitoring illness, and searching for a way to stop the spreading rot.
localized.vision_zh: 一名父亲带着儿子穿越受感染的高地废墟，搜集物资、监控病变，并寻找阻止腐败蔓延的方法。

source_record.title: Pip's Brave Little Roar
source_record.description: Help Pip the Dino travel through the colorful valley to find the lost baby dinosaur and learn how to be brave.
source_record.theme: A shy young dinosaur lives in a colorful prehistoric valley but is too scared to roar like the others. When a storm separates the herd, they must find their voice to save a baby dino.

hero.name: Pip the Dino
hero.description: Pip is a small green dinosaur with bright golden eyes and tiny stubby horns. Though he lives in a valley full of loud, confident dinosaurs, Pip has always been afraid to roar. Gentle, curious, and kind-hearted, he would rather help others quietly than stand in the spotlight — but deep inside, he dreams of finding his own brave voice.

localized.vision_en: A timid young dinosaur travels through a colorful valley to rescue a lost hatchling and learns courage through small acts of help.
localized.vision_zh: 一只胆小的小恐龙穿越多彩山谷寻找失踪幼崽，并在一次次帮助他人的行动中学会勇敢。

source_record.title: The Inverted Scribe
source_record.description: You are the Redact, a being bound to enforce the Grand Script. A rogue warrior has defied the story, and your duty is to silence him. But his defiance echoes your own hidden doubts. Walk the inverted world, gather fragments of forbidden truth, and decide: will you uphold the script or turn your silence toward the Authors?
source_record.theme: In a world where the sky is parchment and oceans drip upward, a being bound to enforce a cosmic script must decide whether to follow the story or break it.

hero.name: The Redact
hero.description: A being of ink and shadow, once a Higher One, now exiled to the inverted world. Bound by chains of cosmic ink to enforce the Grand Script, he silences those who defy the story. His own doubts grow with each erasure.

localized.vision_en: A servant of a cosmic script hunts a rogue warrior through an inverted world, gathers forbidden truths, and decides whether to defy the authors.
localized.vision_zh: 一名宇宙剧本的执行者在倒置世界追捕叛逆武者、收集禁忌真相，并决定是否反抗所谓作者。

source_record.title: The Surplus of Hope
source_record.description: You are Cal Henderson, a Disaster Adjuster for the BMD. You've been sent to Oakhaven to 'Balance the Sheets'—which usually means making sure people lose their jobs or break their legs to compensate for their good fortune. However, you've decided the system is rigged. Your goal is to navigate the suspiciously perfect streets of Oakhaven, avoid the scrutiny of your BMD handlers, and teach the locals how to weaponize their statistical anomalies to crash the BMD's central servers.
source_record.theme:
In America, "Success" isn't just hard work; it's a regulated commodity. The BMD is a secret federal agency that manages the "Luck Supply" of the United States. Every lottery win, "overnight" viral success, and miraculous survival is orchestrated by underpaid agents in a windowless building in Des Moines, Iowa.

The Plot: "The Surplus of Hope"
The Conflict: Due to a massive accounting error in the BMD’s "Inspiration Division," a small, unremarkable town in Nebraska called Oakhaven has accidentally received a 400% surplus of "Golden Opportunities."

The Incident: The town is becoming a utopia. Every scratch-off ticket is a winner. Gas prices are 10 cents. Everyone’s high school sweetheart has moved back to town and is suddenly single. The problem? Luck is a zero-sum game. If Oakhaven stays this lucky, the rest of the Midwest is scheduled for a literal rain of frogs and a total collapse of the cellular network.

The Clever Twist: Cal is sent in to "Balance the Sheets." But he realizes the BMD isn't just regulating luck; they’re hoarding it for the top 0.1%. He decides to go rogue, not by making the town unlucky, but by teaching the townsfolk how to "weaponize" their luck to take down the BMD’s main server in D.C.

Adult/Cynical: It’s a metaphor for the "Rigged System" but played for laughs. It deals with the idea that for every winner, there’s a loser, and the "referees" are just guys in bad suits.

Deep/Clever: It explores the American Dream as a literal, bureaucratic machine.

The Humor: It’s dry, fast-paced, and uses profanity as a punctuation mark for Cal’s exhaustion with the universe.

hero.name: Caleb "Cal" Henderson
hero.description: A man who looks like he’s been through a tumble dryer full of gravel. He’s a "Disaster Adjuster" for the BMD. His job isn't to make people lucky; it’s to distribute the "Residual Spillage"—the bad luck that’s left over when someone else gets too much of the good stuff.

localized.vision_en: A disaster auditor sent to punish unusual good fortune secretly helps a perfect town weaponize statistical anomalies against an oppressive bureau.
localized.vision_zh: 一名被派去惩罚异常好运的灾难审计员暗中帮助完美小镇利用统计异常，对抗压迫性的管理机构。

source_record.title: The Worst Best Date Ever: Her Night Out
source_record.description: Lily Hart is on a first date with the charming but guarded Noah Reed. Between spilled drinks, run-ins with exes, and crushing social anxiety, she must navigate the night's tiny disasters to find a real connection or at least a funny story.
source_record.theme:
The Worst Best Date Ever: Her Night Out

Lily Hart is heading out on a first date she’s been secretly excited about all week. She tells herself it’s just dinner, but every small thing feels like it matters: what she wears, what she says, how she reacts when things go wrong. And things do go wrong. A drink is spilled, an awkward silence stretches too long, and someone from the past appears at exactly the wrong moment. The night becomes a chain of tiny disasters that force Lily to decide whether she hides her nerves behind humour, keeps the peace at all costs, or risks being honest about how she feels.

Her date, Noah Reed, is charming but emotionally guarded, the kind of person who tries hard but struggles to explain himself when it counts. Misunderstandings build quickly, and Lily must choose whether to smooth things over, challenge him when he hurts her feelings, or quietly pull away. The story becomes less about having a perfect date and more about whether two people can stay open with each other when everything feels awkward and exposed. By the end of the night, Lily may walk away with a deeper connection, a bittersweet lesson, or a story she’ll laugh about years later.

Narratively, this version focuses on emotional safety, trust, and the tension between self-respect and attraction. The tone balances warm romantic comedy with moments of vulnerability, where small choices carry big emotional weight. Visually, the world is styled like a modern rom-com: softly lit city streets, expressive faces, cosy cafés and glowing evening skies that contrast with the inner chaos of the characters.

hero.name: Lily Hart
hero.description: One night. One date. A thousand ways to say the wrong thing.

localized.title_en: The Worst Best Date Ever: Her Night Out
localized.title_zh: 最糟也最好的约会：她的夜晚
localized.vision_en: A nervous first date spirals through spilled drinks, surprise encounters, and social mishaps while two people try to form an honest connection.
localized.vision_zh: 一场紧张的初次约会接连遭遇洒饮料、意外碰面和社交事故，两个人仍试图建立真诚联系。

source_record.title: Ashes of Command
source_record.description: You are Alex Mercer, a hardened soldier leading a unit in a post-nuclear war wasteland. Build your reputation by capturing locations, securing supplies, forming alliances, and outmaneuvering rivals. Every choice risks death or glory in this endless struggle for power.
source_record.theme: The world has collapsed into war. After a chain of nuclear strikes and cyberattacks crippled global governments, nations fractured into military zones controlled by surviving commanders, warlords, and desperate civilian militias. Cities lie in ruins. Supply lines are broken. Satellites fall from the sky. But war did not end civilization — it simply changed who rules it. Across the shattered continents, new powers are rising. Some fight to restore order. Others fight to rule the ashes. Alex Mercer leads a small surviving unit trying to reclaim territory, secure resources, and build alliances with scattered factions. Every decision matters. Capture strategic locations. Secure weapons and supplies. Choose allies carefully — today’s partner may become tomorrow’s enemy. In the ruins of the old world, reputation spreads faster than bullets. And the leaders who rise now will shape what humanity becomes next.

hero.name: Alex Mercer
hero.description: A hardened soldier in his mid-30s with close-cropped dark hair, tired eyes, and a weathered face marked by dust and old scars. He wears mismatched military gear — combat vest, worn tactical jacket, and a rifle slung across his back — the look of someone who has survived battles that ended entire armies.

localized.vision_en: A soldier leads a unit through a post-nuclear wasteland, capturing positions, securing supplies, and balancing alliances against rival commanders.
localized.vision_zh: 一名军人带队穿越核战废土，争夺据点、保障补给，并在联盟与敌对指挥官之间维持权力平衡。

source_record.title: The Steel City Scourge
source_record.description: Xanny Pacquiao, a vigilante driven by rage, must systematically dismantle the drug trade poisoning Pittsburgh, using any means necessary.
source_record.theme: Set in the dirty streets of Pittsburgh Pennsylvania. Xanny Pacquiao is on a mission to find drug dealers and stop them from distributing more drugs. Violent, gory, dramatic. Xanny will do whatever it takes to annihilate every drug dealer in town, no matter what it takes.

hero.name: Xanny Pacquiao
hero.description: He's a comedian by day and a hero by night.

localized.vision_en: A furious vigilante dismantles a city's criminal supply network by gathering evidence, disrupting operations, and surviving retaliation.
localized.vision_zh: 一名愤怒的义警通过搜集证据、破坏犯罪网络并应对报复，逐步清除毒害城市的供应链。

source_record.title: Hearts Entwined at Rosewood Manor
source_record.description: You are Clara Hayes, a passionate antique restorer seeking a fresh start in Oakhaven. Claim your half of Rosewood Manor, but share it with grumpy architect Liam for 30 days. Turn arguments into connection while saving the manor from developers.
source_record.theme:
The misty, picturesque, and gossipy seaside town of Oakhaven, featuring cozy local pubs, stormy cliffside walks, and the sprawling, drafty estate known as Rosewood Manor.

Outline: Clara arrives in Oakhaven to claim her inheritance, only to discover a massive catch in her late aunt's will: the other half of Rosewood Manor was left to Liam, a notoriously grumpy (and frustratingly handsome) local architect. Liam wants to sell the land to developers; Clara wants to restore the manor to its former glory. The will dictates they must live in the house together for 30 days before deciding its fate. Forced to share a kitchen, a single working bathroom, and cozy fireside evenings during raging coastal storms, their biting arguments slowly soften into undeniable chemistry. Clara must figure out how to save her dream home without losing her heart to the man trying to tear it down.

hero.name: Clara Hayes
hero.description: A passionate but currently burnt-out antique restorer who just inherited half of a crumbling, centuries-old coastal manor. Clara is fiercely determined, highly creative, and uses her work to avoid dealing with a recent, messy heartbreak. She is looking for a fresh start and a quiet place to heal, but she is entirely unprepared for the stubbornness of the man sharing her new roof.

localized.title_zh: 玫瑰木庄园的交织之心
localized.vision_en: An antique restorer must share a decaying manor with a difficult architect, repair the estate, resist developers, and build trust over thirty days.
localized.vision_zh: 一名古董修复师必须与难相处的建筑师共住破败庄园，在三十天内修复宅邸、抵御开发商并建立信任。

source_record.title: L'Ombre du Masque
source_record.description: Incarnant Helena, vous devez bâtir votre réputation dans les rues dangereuses de la ville. Chaque choix, chaque alliance, chaque combat peut accroître ou briser votre influence. Survivez, prospérez, et devenez une légende.
source_record.theme: En 2026, une vague de crimes violents frappe la ville. Un tueur insaisissable, Ghostface, sème la terreur. Vous devez bâtir votre réputation dans l'ombre, entre alliances et trahisons.

hero.name: Helena
hero.description: Jeune femme impulsive et débrouillarde, marquée par un passé tragique. Elle ne compte que sur elle-même et n'hésite pas à dire ce qu'elle pense. Loyale envers ceux qui gagnent sa confiance.

localized.vision_en: A masked survivor builds influence across dangerous streets where every alliance, confrontation, and betrayal can strengthen or destroy her reputation.
localized.vision_zh: 一名戴面具的幸存者在危险街区积累影响力，每次结盟、对抗与背叛都可能巩固或摧毁其声望。

source_record.title: Echoes of the Clone Wars
source_record.description: As Darth Revan, forge your legend by gaining reputation across star systems—through battles, trade, alliances, and covert deals—shaping the outcome of the Clone Wars without a final objective.
source_record.theme: In the heart of the Clone Wars, the resurrected Sith Lord Darth Revan and his Jedi wife Bastila Shan return as the hidden parents of Anakin Skywalker, navigating a galaxy torn between the Republic and the Separatists while the secret ruler Darth Sidious pulls the strings.

hero.name: Darth Revan
hero.description: A resurrected Sith Lord wielding a purple and red lightsaber, clad in a Mandalorian mask and dark robes, possessing mastery of Force powers and a legendary reputation.

localized.vision_en: A fallen mystic warrior shapes a galactic civil war through fleet battles, trade, covert deals, and shifting alliances across star systems.
localized.vision_zh: 一名失势的神秘武者通过舰队战、贸易、秘密交易与跨星系联盟改变银河内战走向。

source_record.title: Terminator Resistance: Infiltration Protocol
source_record.description: You are Lena Calder, a hardened resistance leader in a machine-dominated world. Navigate ruins, manage resources, ally with survivors, and sabotage AI facilities. Every choice risks detection by hunter-killers or betrayal from within.
source_record.theme:
The Terminator

Decades after a catastrophic AI uprising, humanity survives in scattered resistance cells hiding among the ruins of once-great cities. The machine network that dominates the planet continues to evolve, producing deadlier hunter-killer units with every passing year.

You are Lena Calder, leader of a resistance squad that discovers a hidden machine research facility buried beneath a destroyed metropolis. Intelligence suggests the AI is developing a new generation of infiltration units capable of blending perfectly with humans.

Your mission begins as sabotage, but quickly becomes something larger. The deeper you infiltrate the machine complex, the more you realize the AI is preparing for a second phase of the war—one that may erase the last free humans forever.

Your decisions could ignite a rebellion… or trigger the machines’ final victory.

⸻

hero.name: Lena Calder
hero.description: Lena Calder is a hardened resistance fighter raised in the ruins of a world conquered by machines. Tactical, fearless, and driven by a fierce determination to reclaim humanity’s future, she has spent her life battling robotic armies that patrol the wastelands. Lena believes the war isn’t over—it’s only beginning.

localized.vision_en: A resistance leader crosses machine-occupied ruins, manages scarce resources, recruits survivors, and sabotages adaptive AI facilities without being detected.
localized.vision_zh: 一名抵抗组织领袖穿越机器占领的废墟，管理稀缺资源、招募幸存者，并在不被发现的情况下破坏自适应 AI 设施。

source_record.title: Giacomino: Il Guardiano delle Galassie
source_record.description: Sei Giacomino, un gattino nero con pistole laser. La tua missione è sconfiggere l'alieno Whisky e liberare la Terra per Carletto. Usa il tuo coraggio e la tecnologia spaziale per trionfare.
source_record.theme:
il mondo è stato conquistato dagli alieni e Giacomino deve salvare l' umanità per il suo padrone Carletto.
il capo degli alieni si chiama Whisky ed è tutto verde con degli occhi molto grandi e neri.
ci sono 4 posti in cui Giacomino può andare:
La Base Militare
La casa di Carletto
La Cat Force, base dei gatti
bidoni della spazzatura
Come aiutante di Giacomino c'è: Jack che è un suo grande amico

hero.name: Giacomino guardiano delle Galassie e dell' Iperspazio
hero.description:
è un gattino di colore nero e combatte per salvare la terra dagli alieni che l' hanno invasa. 
Vaga per il mondo di gioco con delle pistole laser.

localized.vision_en: A small black space adventurer armed with laser tools travels between planets to defeat an invader and free Earth.
localized.vision_zh: 一名携带激光工具的黑色小冒险家穿梭行星，击败入侵者并解放地球。

source_record.title: Long Thần Chi Thể: Hồi Kết Của Màn Đêm
source_record.description: Dẫn dắt Nguyễn Minh qua một Hà Nội huyền bí, nơi thực tại và tâm linh đan xen. Sử dụng giọng văn sử thi, trang trọng nhưng dễ hiểu. Tập trung vào sự phát triển nội tâm của Minh từ một sinh viên thành một anh hùng, và những lựa chọn đạo đức khi đối mặt với quyền năng của Long Thần.
source_record.theme: Nguyễn Minh is an ordinary university student in Hanoi, struggling with exams and expectations. But after a mysterious encounter at an ancient temple, he begins to see things others cannot — glowing spirits, hidden creatures, and symbols burned into the air. An ancient dragon, once protector of Vietnam, has chosen him as its vessel. As dark forces rise and ancient enemies awaken, Minh must grow stronger, unlock hidden abilities, and decide whether to protect humanity — or reshape its destiny.

hero.name: Nguyễn Minh
hero.description: ordinary university student in Hanoi

localized.vision_en: A student crosses a mystical Hanoi where reality overlaps the spirit world, growing into a hero while deciding how to use dragon power responsibly.
localized.vision_zh: 一名学生穿越现实与灵界交叠的神秘河内，在成长为英雄的过程中决定如何负责任地使用龙神力量。

source_record.title: Winter's Secret: The Woman in White
source_record.description: You are Nathan Sky, a hopeless romantic on a ski trip to Aspen with friends. But the lodge holds a legend of the Woman in White, and each friend has a secret. Uncover the truth, mend friendships, and maybe find love before the weekend ends.
source_record.theme: A romantic winter getaway to a mountain lodge hides a chilling legend and buried secrets among friends, where love and truth must be uncovered before the weekend ends.

hero.name: Nathan Sky
hero.description: A 19-year-old hopeless romantic and dreamer, hiding his sensitive side behind a teasing exterior. On academic probation, he returns to his hometown lodge, where memories of the past and the mystery of the Woman in White await.

localized.title_en: Winter's Secret: The Woman in White
localized.vision_en: A ski-lodge weekend becomes a romantic supernatural mystery as friends reveal secrets and a local legend begins to manifest.
localized.vision_zh: 滑雪旅馆周末逐渐变成浪漫的超自然谜案，朋友们暴露秘密，而当地白衣传说开始显现。

source_record.title: Cienie Wielkiego Miasta
source_record.description: Wcielasz się w Michała, który nagle odkrywa ukrytą warstwę rzeczywistości w nowoczesnej metropolii. Musisz zarządzać swoim zdrowiem psychicznym i fizycznym, unikając uwagi tajemniczych frakcji, które polują na takich jak Ty. Czy zaakceptujesz swoje przeznaczenie, czy spróbujesz przed nim uciec?
source_record.theme: Zawsze byłeś zwykłą osobą, żyjącą w cieniu wielkiego miasta. Ale pewnej nocy wszystko się zmienia. Zaczynasz widzieć rzeczy, których inni nie widzą. Ktoś cię obserwuje. Ktoś zna twoje imię. W świecie pełnym sekretów i niebezpieczeństw musisz zdecydować, kim się staniesz. Twoje wybory zadecydują o twoim losie.

hero.name: Michał Kowalczyk
hero.description: Michał nigdy nie uważał się za wyjątkowego. Żył spokojnie, unikając problemów. Ale po tej nocy wszystko się zmieniło. Czuje, że coś w nim się obudziło. Coś, czego nie rozumie. Teraz musi zdecydować, czy zaakceptuje swoje przeznaczenie, czy spróbuje przed nim uciec.

localized.vision_en: A city resident discovers a hidden supernatural layer, protects physical and mental health, and evades factions hunting newly awakened people.
localized.vision_zh: 一名都市居民发现隐藏的超自然层面，必须维护身心状态并躲避追捕觉醒者的神秘派系。

source_record.title: Тринадцатый этаж: Тень района
source_record.description: Исследуй бетонные лабиринты, собирай аномальные улики и балансируй на грани безумия, чтобы спасти район от серого небытия.
source_record.theme: В обычном подмосковном районе начинают пропадать люди, а в лифтах старых девятиэтажек появилась кнопка несуществующего 13-го этажа. Даниле предстоит спуститься в бетонные лабиринты, чтобы договориться с Духом Района и предотвратить поглощение реальности серой пустотой.

hero.name: Данила «Проводник»
hero.description: Бывший электрик с усталым взглядом и вечно дымящейся сигаретой. Носит старую кожаную куртку, которая защищает от сглаза лучше, чем от ветра. Его левая рука покрыта татуировками-схемами, которые светятся, когда рядом проявляется «изнанка» города.

localized.vision_en: A resident explores concrete labyrinths, gathers anomalous clues, and manages a fraying mind to stop a district from fading into gray nothingness.
localized.vision_zh: 一名居民探索混凝土迷宫、收集异常线索并控制不断崩溃的理智，以阻止整个街区坠入灰色虚无。

source_record.title: E-스포츠의 정점: 박민재의 비상
source_record.description: 낡은 PC방의 어둠 속에서 빛나는 모니터만이 당신의 세계였습니다. 하지만 이제 전 세계가 당신의 컨트롤을 주목합니다. 명문 프로게임단 '알파'의 제안부터 고독한 승부사의 길까지, 모든 선택은 당신의 몫입니다. 당신의 반응 속도와 멘탈이 역사를 새로 쓸 것입니다.
source_record.theme: 당신은 평범한 게이머였습니다. 아무도 당신의 이름을 몰랐습니다. 하지만 어느 날, 한 경기에서 모든 것이 바뀝니다. 누군가 당신의 플레이를 보고 있습니다. 이제 당신의 선택이 모든 것을 결정합니다 — 팀에 들어갈 것인가, 혼자 싸울 것인가, 명성을 쫓을 것인가, 아니면 자신만의 길을 만들 것인가. 당신의 전설은 지금 시작됩니다.

hero.name: 박민재
hero.description: 민재는 작은 PC방에서 시작했습니다. 아무도 그의 이름을 몰랐고, 아무도 그의 가능성을 보지 못했습니다. 하지만 그는 포기하지 않았습니다. 그는 누구보다 집중했고, 누구보다 빠르게 배웠습니다. 평범한 게이머였던 그는 이제 선택의 순간 앞에 서 있습니다. 이 기회를 잡을 것인가, 아니면 다시 그림자로 돌아갈 것인가. 그의 선택이 그의 운명을 결정할 것입니다.

localized.vision_en: A gifted player rises from a worn internet cafe toward professional competition, balancing training, team offers, public pressure, and mental endurance.
localized.vision_zh: 一名天赋选手从老旧网吧走向职业赛场，在训练、战队邀约、公众压力与心理耐力之间做出选择。

source_record.title: The Great Orbit Race 2276
source_record.description: You are Orio, a determined rookie from a small lunar colony. In the year 2276, the Great Orbit Race is the only thing that matters. To win, you must navigate the dangerous world of high-speed engineering, find a loyal crew, and survive the cutthroat politics of the black market. Every decision in the cockpit and the hangar determines if you bring glory home or burn up in the atmosphere.
source_record.theme:
The Great Orbit Race

Every year, a huge event takes place in orbit - a race around the Earth. Teams across the world work to engineer super space cars to race.

You are Orio, a rookie, who's learning the craft of Orbital racing.

Find allies, engineers and team to help prepare you for the biggest and most dangerous race in history. Beware the underworld, the black market of parts and gamblers looking to fix or bribe.

You must win the Orbital Race 2276 and bring glory and pride to your small colony. Prepare well and use instincts and decisions in race to bring victory home.

Epic sci-fi adventure with crazy space car inventions. Ready Player One style vibes.

hero.name: Orio
hero.description: A rookie from a poor upbringing

localized.vision_en: A lunar rookie assembles a loyal crew, tunes a high-speed craft, and survives black-market politics to win a dangerous orbital championship.
localized.vision_zh: 一名月球新秀组建可靠车组、调校高速飞行器，并在黑市政治中求生，以赢得危险的轨道锦标赛。

source_record.title: Maestro Academy: Art of Unity
source_record.description: Play as Evan Zenith, a first‑year prodigy at Maestro Academy. Explore the campus, train in music, painting, dance, acting, sculpting and singing, challenge rivals, uncover academy secrets, and strive to connect every art form while climbing the ranks.
source_record.theme: At Maestro Academy, prodigious artists compete in a strict ranking system, and a rebellious first‑year prodigy seeks to prove all art forms are linked while navigating rivalries, secret challenges, and hidden academy mysteries.

hero.name: Evan Zenith
hero.description:
Role: Main Protagonist | Age: 17 | Academy: Maestro Academy
 
✨ Personality
 
Smart, calm, easygoing, athletic, and highly skilled in all arts.
 
🎭 Art Mastery
 
Visual arts, music, performing arts, writing, photography & film.
 
📌 Strengths & Weaknesses
 
✅ Strengths: Mastery of all arts, focused, creative, physically fit.
❌ Weaknesses: Not very aware of surroundings, rebellious, bad at reading situations, over-perfects work.
 
🎯 Background
 
From a family of artists; studies independently to prove all art forms are connected.
 
🎨 Style
 
Relaxed, neat, practical, and never overly formal.

localized.vision_en: A first-year prodigy studies music, painting, dance, acting, sculpture, and song while challenging rivals and uncovering secrets across an arts academy.
localized.vision_zh: 一名一年级天才在艺术学院学习音乐、绘画、舞蹈、表演、雕塑与歌唱，同时挑战对手并揭开校园秘密。

source_record.title: Robocop: Enforcer of New Detroit
source_record.description: You are Officer Marcus Steele, cybernetic enforcer in chaotic New Detroit. Restore order amid gang wars, police actions, and corporate drone deployments. Uncover the truth behind the corporation's role in the escalating violence. Navigate gritty streets, balancing machine directives with fading human memories.
source_record.theme:
In the sprawling megacity of New Detroit, crime syndicates have grown powerful enough to challenge the government itself. When a powerful corporation secretly deploys autonomous security drones across Robocop

The city, violent confrontations erupt between gangs, police, and corporate forces.

You are Officer Marcus Steele, a cybernetic enforcer programmed to restore order. As you patrol the city’s streets, you uncover evidence that the same corporation funding the security program may be orchestrating the chaos.

With each investigation and confrontation, Steele must balance his machine directives with his fading human instincts. The line between law enforcement and corporate control grows thinner, and the question becomes clear:

Are you protecting the city… or enforcing someone else’s vision of order?

hero.name: Robocop
hero.description: Robocop is a cybernetically enhanced law enforcement officer created after a brutal shootout left him near death. Part human, part machine, Steele now serves as the city’s most powerful crime-fighting unit. While his mechanical systems give him unmatched strength and precision, fragments of his human past still surface—memories that remind him why justice matters.

localized.vision_en: A cybernetic officer restores order during gang conflict and corporate drone deployments while investigating who profits from the escalating violence.
localized.vision_zh: 一名义体警员在帮派冲突和企业无人机行动中恢复秩序，并调查谁在不断升级的暴力中获利。

source_record.title: Shadows of the Silver Moon
source_record.description: You are Dr. Alexander Myers, an investigator for the secret Society of the Silver Moon. Explore ten locations, interview witnesses, and determine if the paranormal is real. If it is, find a way to eliminate the threat. Build your reputation through successful investigations and alliances.
source_record.theme: A secret society investigator hunts the paranormal across 1990s America, uncovering real monsters, frauds, and conspiracies while building a reputation as the world's foremost occult expert.

hero.name: Dr. Alexander Myers
hero.description: A former FBI agent with a PhD in folklore and a black belt. His brother was killed by a vampire, driving him to join the Society of the Silver Moon. Skilled in combat, investigation, and discerning truth from lies.

localized.vision_en: A secret-society investigator examines paranormal cases across ten locations, interviews witnesses, and builds a reputation by resolving genuine threats.
localized.vision_zh: 一名秘密协会调查员在十个地点调查灵异案件、询问证人，并通过解决真正威胁建立声望。

source_record.title: 鴉森学園：境界の秘密
source_record.description: 鴉森学園へようこそ。ここでは静寂が牙を剥き、影が真実を語ります。あなたは転校生として、この学園に隠された『境界』の謎を解き明かさなければなりません。誰を信じ、何を疑うか。あなたの鋭い洞察力だけが、闇の中の道標となるでしょう。
source_record.theme: あなたは新しい学校に転校してきました。誰もあなたのことを知りません。しかし、この学校には何かがおかしい。誰かがあなたを見ています。誰かがあなたを知っています。あなたの選択が、あなたの運命を決めます。友情、秘密、そして力。あなたの物語は、今始まります。

hero.name: 悠斗
hero.description: 悠斗は普通の学生として生きてきました。しかし、彼はずっと自分が他の人と違うと感じていました。新しい学校に転校してきた今、彼の周りで奇妙なことが起こり始めます。人々は彼を見つめ、何かを期待しているようです。彼の選択が、彼が何者になるのかを決めるでしょう。

localized.title_en: Ravenwood Academy: Secret of the Boundary
localized.vision_en: A transfer student investigates a school where silence becomes dangerous and shadows reveal clues about a hidden boundary.
localized.vision_zh: 一名转学生调查一所沉默会变得危险、暗影会泄露线索的学校，并揭开隐藏边界之谜。

source_record.title: The Last Train Home
source_record.description: The train lurches forward as explosions echo in the distance. A mother begs you to help find her missing child in another carriage. The conductor warns there may be no time to stop. You are Tomas Virel, and the lives of thousands depend on your grit and your wrench.
source_record.theme:
The Last Train Home

Description
A massive evacuation train crosses a war-torn continent. Inside are families, soldiers, strangers, and secrets. You must make impossible choices: who to save, what to sacrifice, and how to hold onto hope as the world collapses outside the windows.

Opening scene
The train lurches forward as explosions echo in the distance. A mother begs you to help find her missing child in another carriage. The conductor warns there may be no time to stop.

Narrative style
	•	Emotional human drama
	•	Ethical dilemmas
	•	Relationship-driven branching

Artistic style
	•	Painterly realism
	•	Firelight, smoke, steel interiors
	•	Warm vs cold contrast

hero.name: Tomas Virel
hero.description: Former railway engineer turned guardian of the passengers.

localized.vision_en: An engineer keeps an evacuation train moving through a collapsing war zone while searching its carriages for a missing child.
localized.vision_zh: 一名工程师在崩溃战区维持疏散列车运转，同时穿过各节车厢寻找失踪儿童。

source_record.title: The Disasters of Dave
source_record.description: You are Dave, an ordinary person in Gravelspit, the world's most dysfunctional town. Every day is a struggle against absurdity. Navigate broken bureaucracy, strange neighbors, and failed infrastructure. Your goal is to survive, maybe thrive, or just not accidentally set the town hall on fire again. Use your wits and your luck to handle the bizarre requests of the locals and the constant failures of modern society.
source_record.theme:
You wake up in a town where nothing works properly, nobody behaves normally, and every decision spirals into chaos. The mayor is corrupt but incompetent, your boss might be running a pyramid scheme, and the local police officer keeps asking you for advice despite clearly knowing less than you do.

Every choice you make affects how people see you. Become a respected leader, a feared troublemaker, a local legend, or the town’s biggest disaster. Form alliances, make enemies, start businesses, expose secrets, or accidentally destroy everything.

Your choices permanently shape the town—and your reputation within it.

hero.name: Dave
hero.description: Dave is a completely ordinary person stuck in the most dysfunctional town imaginable. He has no special powers, no money, and no plan—just terrible luck and a strange ability to make every situation worse or unexpectedly brilliant.

localized.vision_en: An ordinary resident navigates a dysfunctional town's broken bureaucracy, strange neighbors, failing infrastructure, and escalating accidental crises.
localized.vision_zh: 一名普通居民应对失灵小镇的破败官僚体系、奇怪邻居、故障设施和不断升级的意外危机。

source_record.title: Neo-Rio: O Despertar do Zero
source_record.description: Você é Lucas “Zero” Andrade, um piloto de drones das favelas verticais de Neo-Rio. O asfalto é escasso, o céu é vigiado e a única forma de subir na vida é acelerando. Quando um hack mal sucedido coloca você na mira da Lux Energy, a maior corporação da cidade, você deve usar suas habilidades de piloto e seus instintos de rua para sobreviver. Entre corridas clandestinas e missões de sabotagem, você decidirá o destino de uma cidade que nunca dorme e nunca esquece.
source_record.theme: In a cyberpunk future Rio, megacorporations control energy, media, and even memory. You start as a small-time racer but get recruited into a high-stakes underground resistance. Compete in illegal hover races, hack corporate networks, and choose between fame, money, or revolution. Every decision shifts your reputation — hero, outlaw, or corporate puppet?

hero.name: Lucas “Zero” Andrade
hero.description: A street-smart drone racer from the lower districts of Neo-Rio, surviving off illegal night races between skyscrapers.

localized.vision_en: A drone pilot from a vertical district races through watched skies, takes sabotage jobs, and challenges the corporation hunting him after a failed hack.
localized.vision_zh: 一名来自垂直城区的无人机驾驶员在受监控的天空竞速、执行破坏任务，并反抗因失败入侵而追捕自己的企业。

source_record.title: Sangre y Tequila: El Legado de los Del Castillo
source_record.description: Guía a Alejandro a través de los pasillos de la alta sociedad y los campos de agave. Deberás elegir entre la lealtad a tu apellido o el deseo de tu corazón mientras desentierras secretos que tu padre juró llevarse a la tumba. Usa tu influencia y pasión para navegar traiciones familiares y encontrar la verdad sobre Mariana antes de que la próxima gran gala destruya todo lo que amas.
source_record.theme: Alejandro se enamora de Mariana, la hija del rival más grande de su padre. Entre bodas canceladas en el último minuto, bofetadas dramáticas, gemelos perdidos y revelaciones sobre testamentos ocultos, Alejandro debe luchar contra su propia familia para estar con Mariana. Todo culmina en una fiesta de gala donde se descubre que Mariana no es quien dice ser, pero el amor de Alejandro es más fuerte que la venganza.

hero.name: Alejandro del Castillo
hero.description: El heredero de una fortuna tequilera. Atractivo, apasionado y atormentado por un secreto familiar que podría destruir su imperio.

localized.vision_en: A family heir crosses elite salons and agave fields, choosing between loyalty and love while exposing secrets before a decisive gala.
localized.vision_zh: 一名家族继承人往返上流社交场与龙舌兰田，在忠诚与爱情之间选择，并在关键晚宴前揭露秘密。

source_record.title: Mars Portal Breach
source_record.description: You are Kai Volex, a hardened orbital marine investigating a silent Mars mining colony. An experimental portal has torn open a rift to a hostile dimension, unleashing horrors. Survive the facility, confront the creatures, and seal the breach before the invasion spreads.
source_record.theme:
A mining colony on Mars has gone silent after an experimental energy portal project tears open something far older and darker than anyone expected. Strange signals echo through the abandoned facility, and the few surviving distress messages speak of creatures emerging from the gateway beneath the planet’s crust.

You are Kai Volex, sent in alone to investigate the collapse of the research complex. As you descend through the shattered corridors of the facility, the truth becomes clear: the portal was not simply a gateway through space—it opened a path to a hostile dimension where monstrous forces now spill into the human world.

Every corridor hides new horrors. Every decision could mean survival or annihilation. The deeper you go, the more the boundary between worlds begins to break apart. Your choices determine whether the invasion is contained… or whether Mars becomes the first fallen world of a spreading nightmare.

Humanity’s survival may depend on one soldier pushing deeper into the darkness than anyone ever intended.

Artstyle like DOOM the game, pixel

hero.name: Kai Volex
hero.description: A hardened orbital marine stationed on the frontier of humanity’s deep-space colonies. Scarred from years of fighting insurgents and rogue machines, he is known for surviving missions no one else walks away from. Quiet, relentless, and driven by an unbreakable will, Kael has one rule: when something threatens humanity, he finishes it.

localized.vision_en: An orbital marine enters a silent Mars colony where an experimental portal released hostile creatures and must survive long enough to seal it.
localized.vision_zh: 一名轨道陆战队员进入寂静的火星殖民地，面对实验传送门释放的敌对生物，并设法生存至封闭裂口。

source_record.title: صقر الرياض: إرث الزهراني
source_record.description: تم استدعاؤك بشكل مفاجئ إلى الرياض بعد اكتشاف صلة خفية بواحدة من أقوى العائلات في المملكة. لا أحد يعرف ما إذا كنت حليفاً، أم تهديداً، أم القائد المستقبلي لشيء أعظم بكثير. بصفتك فيصل الزهراني، تدخل عالماً من الثروة والولاء والأسرار. كل قرار تتخذه يشكل سمعتك ومستقبلك. هل ستصبح القائد المنتظر أم ستكون مجرد ذكرى عابرة في تاريخ العائلة؟
source_record.theme:
The Falcon’s Heir

You are unexpectedly summoned to Riyadh after discovering a hidden connection to one of the most powerful families in the Kingdom. Nobody knows whether you are an ally, a threat, or the future leader of something far greater.

As you step into a world of wealth, loyalty, secrets, and influence, every decision shapes your reputation. Trusted advisors watch you carefully. Rivals test your strength. Powerful figures invite you into private conversations that could change your future forever.

Some believe you are destined to lead. Others want to see you fail.

Your choices determine whether you become respected, feared, betrayed — or legendary.

hero.name: Faisal
hero.description:
Faisal Al-Zahrani grew up without knowing the full truth about his past. Raised in a quiet environment far from the centers of power, he learned independence early, relying on instinct, observation, and quiet determination. He never chased attention, yet people naturally noticed him — there was something in his presence, calm but unyielding, like someone meant for more.

Recently, a message arrived that would change everything.

An invitation. No explanation. Only a name he had never seen before — and a connection to a family whose influence stretches across cities, industries, and generations.

Now standing at the threshold of a world built on loyalty, reputation, and silent power, Faisal must decide who he will become. Some will offer guidance. Others will test him. A few will try to control him.

Every word he speaks, every alliance he forms, every decision he makes will shape his identity.

He can remain an outsider.

Or rise into someone the world cannot ignore.

localized.vision_en: A young outsider enters a powerful Riyadh family network and must shape a reputation amid wealth, loyalty, secrets, and leadership expectations.
localized.vision_zh: 一名年轻外来者进入利雅得强大家族网络，必须在财富、忠诚、秘密和领袖期待之间塑造自己的声望。

source_record.title: The Treehouse of Wonders
source_record.description: Lead Ava and her brother through magical portals found in their backyard treehouse. Keep the story lighthearted, friendly, and exciting. Focus on discovery, solving puzzles, and helping new friends. Use simple words and short sentences perfect for children.
source_record.theme: Two siblings discover their backyard treehouse opens portals to different magical worlds.

hero.name: Ava
hero.description: Ava is adventurous and quick-thinking. She is always the first to climb the highest branch. With wind-tangled hair and scraped knees, she believes the world is bigger than it looks. She is ready to explore whatever magical lands lie beyond the portal.

localized.vision_en: Two siblings enter magical portals hidden in a backyard treehouse, solve friendly puzzles, and help new companions return home.
localized.vision_zh: 兄妹二人通过后院树屋中的魔法传送门进入异世界，解决友善谜题并帮助新伙伴回家。

source_record.title: 機神の戦域
source_record.description: あなたは神谷レン、辺境基地の新人パイロット。古い実験機神に適合できる唯一の操縦者として、企業軍、反乱軍、AI勢力の争いに巻き込まれる。戦闘勝利、仲間集め、機体強化、名声構築を目指せ。生存の緊張感の中で決断を下せ。
source_record.theme:
近未来。世界は巨大企業と軍事国家による戦争に支配されている。

戦場を決めるのは兵士ではなく、巨大な戦闘兵器――機神（きしん）と呼ばれる人型メカだ。
熟練したパイロットは都市一つの運命を変える力を持つ。

神谷レンは辺境の基地に配属された新人パイロット。
しかし偶然にも、古い実験機の機神に適合できる唯一の操縦者であることが判明する。

企業軍、反乱軍、そして謎のAI勢力が機神の力を巡って争う中、レンは戦場へと送り出される。

戦闘に勝利し、仲間を集め、機体を強化し、名声を築け。

この戦争では、最も強いパイロットの名が戦場を支配する。

そしていつか、人々はこう語るだろう。
この戦争の流れを変えたのは――レンの機神だったと。

hero.name: 神谷 レン
hero.description: 二十代前半の若いパイロット。鋭い青い目と短い黒髪を持ち、背が高く細身。整備用ジャケットの下にパイロットスーツを着用。戦場では冷静で集中力が高く、コックピットで別人のような判断力を発揮。新人ながら操縦技術に伝説の兆しあり。

localized.vision_en: A rookie pilot bonds with an old experimental machine and navigates conflict among corporate armies, rebels, and autonomous AI forces.
localized.vision_zh: 一名新手驾驶员与古老实验机体建立连接，并周旋于企业军、反抗军和自主 AI 势力的冲突。

source_record.title: Winchester Circuit
source_record.description: You are building reputation in the gritty, realistic world of British sixth-form tennis culture. Track dates, WTN rating, LTA rank, and social standing. Time advances in compressed weeks for routine training and low-stakes matches, but halts for tournaments, parties, and interpersonal confrontations. NPCs live independent lives, date each other, spread gossip, and react to your choices with lasting consequences. All decisions affect reputation. No ending. Play continues until you quit or a stat reaches zero.
source_record.theme: Endless open-world kingpin life sim set in modern Winchester, England. Player is a 16-year-old Polish-English tennis prodigy navigating sixth-form college, LTA/ITF junior tournaments, house parties, rivalries, and shifting social alliances while building an uncapped reputation through wins, drama, and influence.

hero.name: Marcin Kornijczuk
hero.description: A 16-year-old Polish-English tennis prodigy who has just finished secondary school and is starting sixth form at Peter Symonds College. Ranked nationally in the U18 category, he balances intense training with normal teenage life, parties, and social drama.

localized.vision_en: A student athlete builds a tennis career through training, tournaments, friendships, rivalries, gossip, and a calendar where choices leave lasting social effects.
localized.vision_zh: 一名学生运动员通过训练、赛事、友情、竞争与流言建立网球生涯，日程中的选择会留下长期社交后果。

source_record.title: The Smile Protocol
source_record.description: You are Helix, a man born from the shadows in a city of blinding neon and forced grins. In Joy-City, sadness is a crime and the sun never sets. Navigate the saccharine surface to find the truth behind the Great Smile while keeping your own darkness from being purged.
source_record.theme: A world full of fake happiness

hero.name: Helix
hero.description: A   man frome darkness

localized.vision_en: A shadow-born dissident navigates a city where sadness is illegal, hides forbidden emotions, and investigates the system behind compulsory happiness.

source_record.title: Delta : L'Écho des Mythes
source_record.description: Kuroko, aventurier aveugle de rang B, parcourt librement Delta. Il n'a aucune destinée imposée. Curieux du mana, il cherche à comprendre les lois qui gouvernent la magie et les pouvoirs. Ses voyages le mènent à des peuples, des créatures et des divinités. Bâtissez votre réputation en explorant, en négociant, en combattant et en influençant les factions. Le monde évolue sans vous ; vos choix laissent des traces durables.
