Aventurier de rang B, il voyage librement à travers le monde sans servir de royaume, de faction ou de divinité. Extrêmement curieux, il cherche constamment à comprendre la logique du mana, des pouvoirs, des serments et des différentes formes de force. Né avec un potentiel ordinaire, il est devenu extrêmement puissant en étudiant et exploitant les règles du mana, nota

localized.vision_en: A blind adventurer studies the laws of magic by exploring freely, negotiating with peoples and gods, and leaving persistent marks on evolving factions.
localized.vision_zh: 一名盲眼冒险者通过自由探索、与各族及神灵谈判来研究魔法规律，并在演化中的派系上留下持久影响。

source_record.title: 覺醒：遺產之戰
source_record.description: 在霓虹閃爍的現代都市與古老修行的碰撞中，你將扮演陳昊天，探索隱藏在日常背後的超自然世界。通過修煉提升靈氣，與各方勢力博弈，揭開遺物的真相。
source_record.theme: 傳說中，只有少數人能夠掌握真正的力量。當你發現一件古老的遺物時，你的世界開始改變。有人想要保護你，有人想要奪取你的力量。你將成為傳說中的修行者，還是消失於歷史之中？一切取決於你的選擇。

hero.name: 陳昊天
hero.description: 昊天從未認為自己與眾不同。但當力量在他體內覺醒，他意識到自己與這個世界有著更深的聯繫。他的命運，才剛剛開始。

localized.vision_en: A cultivator explores a neon city hiding an ancient supernatural order, increases spiritual power, contests factions, and uncovers a relic's truth.
localized.vision_zh: 一名修行者探索霓虹都市背后的古老超自然秩序，提升灵力、周旋各方势力并揭开遗物真相。

source_record.title: Deus Ex: Augmented Shadows
source_record.description: You are Adrian Kade, a calm, analytical augmented agent with neural implants. Probe corporate conspiracies causing glitches in citizens' augmentations. Street-gritty choices drive you through neon-lit shadows toward truth or ruin.
source_record.theme:
Deus Ex

In the near future, powerful corporations control everything from medical technology to global infrastructure. Augmented humans—people enhanced with cybernetic implants—have become both a symbol of progress and a source of social division.

You are Adrian Kade, an intelligence agent investigating a series of mysterious system failures affecting augmented citizens across multiple cities. At first the incidents appear to be random glitches, but evidence soon points toward a hidden network manipulating global technology.

As you navigate corporate towers, underground hacker collectives, and politically charged city districts, the conspiracy grows deeper. Someone is rewriting the rules of human evolution—and they intend to decide who gets to be part of the future.

Your choices will determine whether the world moves toward control, chaos, or something entirely new.

hero.name: Adrian Kade
hero.description: Adrian Kade is an augmented intelligence operative working in a future where cybernetic enhancements and genetic modification have transformed society. Calm, analytical, and highly adaptable, Kade possesses neural implants that allow him to interface directly with digital systems. But in a world where power hides behind corporations and secret networks, knowing the truth can be more dangerous than any weapon.

localized.vision_en: An augmented investigator follows malfunctions in citizens' implants through corporate conspiracies and must choose between exposing truth and personal survival.
localized.vision_zh: 一名义体调查员追查市民植入体故障背后的企业阴谋，并在揭露真相与保全自身之间选择。

source_record.title: O Touro do Submundo
source_record.description: Você é Thiago “Touro” Mendes, um lutador de MMA em ascensão no submundo brasileiro. Entre becos úmidos e luzes de neon de clubes clandestinos, você deve decidir se luta pela honra de sua família ou se vende sua alma para os sindicatos de apostas. Cada soco tem um preço e cada vitória atrai amigos e inimigos perigosos.
source_record.theme: Train, fight, build reputation, and choose your path — fame, integrity, or dangerous shortcuts. Your choices determine whether you become a respected champion or fall into corruption and crime.

hero.name: Thiago “Touro” Mendes
hero.description: A disciplined fighter entering Brazil’s underground MMA scene to support his family.

localized.vision_en: A rising mixed-martial-arts fighter navigates illegal clubs, family honor, betting syndicates, and dangerous relationships where every victory has a price.
localized.vision_zh: 一名冉冉升起的综合格斗选手周旋于地下俱乐部、家族荣誉、博彩集团与危险关系，每场胜利都有代价。

source_record.title: Beat Rebellion: Le Dernier Solo
source_record.description: Dans un futur où le silence est un crime et l'IA compose chaque note, vous incarnez Kevin Druminc. Armé de vos baguettes de batterie capables de projeter des ondes de choc rythmiques, vous devez infiltrer les bastions des labels corrompus. Votre but : organiser un concert illégal pour briser l'hypnose sonore qui asservit l'humanité.
source_record.theme: Un monde post-apocalyptic ou la music est généré uniquement par IA et obligatoire à écouter sous peine d'amende pour enrichir des label et maisons de disques véreux qui ont prix le pouvoir.  Kévin, jeune batteur se cache pour jouer une vrai musique avec son instruments et rêve de jouer sur scène dans un monde où seule la musique sans Instruments généré par IA est toléré pour lobotomiser le peuples pour l'asservir. Il décide de combattre les labels et maison de disques grâce à ses baguettes qui envoient des notes rythmiques qui les achevent pour réussir à jouer sur scène avec son groupe pour libérer la societer grâce à un solo de batterie, qui brisera la lobotomie du peuple qui reprendra le pouvoir.

hero.name: Kevin Druminc
hero.description: Jeune batteur aux yeux bleus de 25ans barbu, avec une casquette noire et une batterie blanche dessus.en hoodie noire et jeans.

localized.vision_en: In a future where AI controls music, a drummer infiltrates fortified labels and organizes an illegal concert to break mass sonic conditioning.
localized.vision_zh: 在 AI 控制音乐的未来，一名鼓手潜入唱片公司堡垒，并组织非法演出以打破大规模声波控制。

source_record.title: Fists of Tomorrow
source_record.description: Clear the streets. Save the city. Don’t lose your last life. You are a lone fighter walking block by block through hostile streets, subway tunnels, rooftop clubs, and abandoned arcades. Each fight is a decision: show mercy or make an example. The city remembers your name as you move toward the boss who controls it all.
source_record.theme:
Fists of Tomorrow

Hero
Clear the streets. Save the city. Don’t lose your last life.

Description
The city used to belong to gangs, neon signs, and the sound of arcade cabinets humming through open doors. Now it’s ruled by crime bosses, corrupt enforcers, and something darker moving in the shadows. You are a lone fighter walking block by block through hostile streets, subway tunnels, rooftop clubs, and abandoned arcades, where every encounter feels like another screen to clear. But this isn’t just about throwing punches — it’s about who you protect, who you spare, and how far you’re willing to go to bring order back to a broken city.

Inspired by the golden age of side-scrolling brawlers, this adventure turns classic beat-’em-up action into a living story. Each fight becomes a decision: do you show mercy or make an example, help the shop owner being shaken down or chase the gang leader escaping into the night? The world remembers how you fight and who you stand up for. Neon lights flicker, synth music echoes through alleyways, and rumours of your name spread as you move forward, one street at a time, toward the boss who controls it all.

Narratively, the story plays like an urban action drama with moments of humour, loyalty, and revenge. Artistically, it draws from arcade classics with bold characters, exaggerated poses, glowing city lights, and rain-soaked streets that look like they belong on a CRT screen — a retro brawler world brought to life as a branching adventure where every “level” is a choice and every victory leaves a mark.

hero.name: Axe
hero.description: A tough ex-cop, hell bent on clearing up the streets

localized.vision_en: A lone fighter clears hostile streets, tunnels, clubs, and arcades while mercy and intimidation shape the city's response before a final boss confrontation.
localized.vision_zh: 一名孤身武者穿过敌对街道、隧道、俱乐部与街机厅，仁慈或威慑会改变城市反应并影响最终首领战。

source_record.title: Clays Of Our Lives: The Sidekick Hunt
source_record.description: Seek the legendary Sculptor's Clay pieces across the animated world to mold the greatest cinematic sidekick for the director, Maestro Mold. But beware, rival filmmakers and rogue clay entities want the power for themselves.
source_record.theme: A claymation movie set. The mission is to find pieces of powerful clay to craft the best sidekick character for the upcoming film "Clays Of Our Lives". Filled with various enemies and traps trying to stop you from accomplishing your goal of forming the best sidekick.

hero.name: ClayMate
hero.description: He's a claymation cat with a tree in its head.

localized.vision_en: An aspiring creator searches an animated clay world for legendary materials while rival filmmakers and rogue sculptures compete for the same power.
localized.vision_zh: 一名创作者在会动的黏土世界寻找传奇材料，同时与竞争导演和失控雕塑争夺同一种力量。

source_record.title: Pip Star-Catcher and the Sleeping Beacon
source_record.description: You are Pip Star-Catcher, a brave young inventor on a quest to save your floating home. Use your Lumina Jar to collect fallen stars and solve puzzles as you travel to the Great Celestial Lighthouse. The world is full of wonder, floating islands, and giant cloud-whales waiting to help you.
source_record.theme: The story takes place in the Aethelgard Archipelago, a breathtaking world of floating islands connected by glowing bridges made of stardust. Recently, the Great Celestial Lighthouse that keeps the islands safely afloat has started to dim, causing islands to drift apart and stars to plummet from the sky. Pip must leave his cozy village and embark on a grand, sky-bound journey to reach the Lighthouse. Along the way, he uses his Lumina Jar to rescue fallen stars, navigates through fluffy thunderstorms, and befriends giant, gentle cloud-whales.

hero.name: Pip Star-Catcher
hero.description: A curious and brave young inventor from the quiet, cloudy village of Glimmergrove. Pip is small for his age but makes up for it with a giant heart and an ever-present, oversized backpack filled with tinkering tools. His most prized possession is his own invention: the Lumina Jar, a magical glass lantern capable of safely catching and storing the light of falling stars.

localized.title_en: Pip Star-Catcher and the Sleeping Beacon
localized.title_zh: 捕星者皮普与沉睡灯塔
localized.vision_en: A young inventor collects fallen stars across floating islands and solves puzzles on the way to awaken a celestial lighthouse.
localized.vision_zh: 一名年轻发明家在浮空岛间收集坠落星辰、解决谜题，并前往唤醒天界灯塔。

source_record.title: The Worst Best Date Ever: His Big Chance
source_record.description: Jake Miller is on the date of his life with Emma Clarke. He needs to stop trying to be 'cool' and start being real before his own ego ruins everything.
source_record.theme:
The Worst Best Date Ever: His Big Chance

Jake Miller has one goal tonight: don’t mess this up. He’s finally on a date with someone he really likes, and he wants to seem confident, funny, and in control — even though he’s anything but. When a waiter drops a tray, his phone lights up with a message from an ex, and a stranger flirts with his date, Jake’s carefully planned evening begins to unravel. Every moment forces him to choose between playing it cool or admitting what he’s really feeling.

His date, Emma Clarke, is sharp-witted and emotionally perceptive. She notices when Jake dodges a question, when he jokes instead of answering, and when jealousy creeps into his voice. As the night spirals through bars, taxis, and late-night conversations, Jake must decide whether to protect his pride or risk vulnerability. The real challenge isn’t impressing Emma — it’s proving he can handle discomfort with honesty instead of bravado.

This version centres on pride versus sincerity and the fear of rejection. The comedy comes from social mishaps and badly timed choices, while the romance grows through moments of genuine openness. Artistically, it plays like a bright, cinematic rom-com with expressive body language, neon-lit streets, and playful framing that highlights awkward pauses, nervous smiles, and emotional turning points.

hero.name: Jake Miller
hero.description: Try not to ruin the night. Accidentally make it unforgettable.

localized.title_en: The Worst Best Date Ever: His Big Chance

source_record.description: Вы — Игорь, человек-невидимка в дешевом костюме. Ваша цель — расторгнуть контракт с корпорацией «Вектор» и выйти из здания, которое внутри больше, чем снаружи. Используйте свой Золотой Степлер и способность сливаться с обоями, чтобы выжить среди офисного безумия.
source_record.theme: Игорь замечает, что в его бизнес-центре 40 этажей снаружи, но внутри их бесконечное количество. Коллеги из отдела бухгалтерии начали приносить в жертву курьеров, чтобы квартальный отчет сошелся, а Генеральный Директор не выходил из кабинета уже 10 лет и, кажется, стал разумным облаком плесени. Игорю нужно уволиться, но по контракту его душа принадлежит корпорации «Вектор» до конца времен.

hero.name: Игорь
hero.description: Менеджер среднего звена. Человек-невидимка в дешевом костюме. Его суперспособность — быть настолько незаметным, что он может проходить сквозь закрытые двери совещаний. Его главный артефакт — «Золотой Степлер», который никогда не заканчивается.

source_record.title: Eclipseborn
source_record.description: The eclipse has passed, but the Blind Ones have risen. As Ryan, a survivor in the fortified town of Haven's Rest, you must gather resources, rally allies, and strike against the horde. Every choice builds your reputation as humanity's shield. Survive, adapt, and lead.

localized.vision_en: After an eclipse awakens sightless predators, a fortified-town survivor gathers resources, rallies allies, and builds a reputation as humanity's shield.
localized.vision_zh: 日食唤醒无眼掠食者后，一名堡垒小镇幸存者收集资源、召集盟友，并以人类之盾的身份积累声望。

source_record.title: 最後の抜刀：目覚める刃
source_record.description: あなたは神谷 悠真として、荒廃した都市の片隅で一本の古い刀を手に取ります。その瞬間、血管を駆け巡る熱い感触が、あなたが単なる青年ではないことを告げています。剣士が狩られるこの時代で、あなたは正体を隠して生き延びるのか、それとも失われた技を取り戻し、世界に抗うのか。冷たい雨が降る街で、あなたの物語が始まります。

hero.name: Tom

localized.vision_zh: 一名普通人因意外引发国际危机，必须躲避追捕、寻找盟友、查清真相并设法逃脱。

source_record.title: Icarus: Frontier Prospector
source_record.description: You are Kyle, a prospector stranded on the hostile frontier of Icarus. Scavenge, craft, and fight to survive. Monitor your vitals, explore diverse biomes, and complete your contract before time runs out. Every choice matters.
source_record.theme:
Icarus: Frontier Prospector is a survival-focused interactive adventure where the player is dropped from orbit onto a dangerous alien world to complete a contract before returning safely to space. After choosing a landing zone such as a forest, desert, swamp, or arctic region, the player must gather resources, manage hunger, thirst, health, and exposure, and establish a base capable of surviving increasingly harsh weather and wildlife threats.

The core gameplay revolves around exploration, crafting, and risk management. Players collect resources such as wood, stone, metals, and rare exotic materials to unlock new technologies, tools, weapons, and structures. Dynamic events such as storms, predator attacks, cave discoveries, equipment failures, and environmental hazards create meaningful choices that can lead to valuable rewards or serious setbacks.

As the story progresses, the player undertakes contracts ranging from surveying unknown regions and hunting dangerous creatures to mining rare resources and recovering lost expeditions. The world continues to evolve between turns, with wildlife migrating, weather systems changing, resources depleting, and rival prospectors establishing their own camps and competing for valuable discoveries.

Success requires balancing short-term survival with long-term progression. Players must decide when to push deeper into dangerous territory, when to improve their base and equipment, and when to begin the journey back to extraction. Completing the contract and reaching orbit results in victory, while death, starvation, exposure, or missing the extraction window can bring the expedition to a permanent end.

hero.name: Kyle
hero.description: A space prospector and astronaut

localized.vision_en: A prospector stranded on a hostile frontier scavenges, crafts, tracks vital signs, crosses dangerous biomes, and races to complete a contract before extraction closes.
localized.vision_zh: 一名被困敌对边境的勘探者搜集、制造、监控生命指标并穿越危险生态区，在撤离窗口关闭前完成合同。

source_record.title: Il Matrimonio in Fuga
source_record.description: Sei Luca, un fotografo di matrimoni la cui vita è appena stata travolta da una sposa in fuga. Naviga tra le strade d'Italia sulla tua Vespa azzurra, gestisci lo stress di un inseguimento nazionale e cerca di catturare il momento perfetto mentre il tuo cuore e la tua carriera sono in bilico. Ogni scelta influenzerà il tuo legame con Giulia e la tua reputazione professionale.
source_record.theme: Luca viene assunto per il "Matrimonio del Secolo" tra una star del cinema e un nobile locale. Peccato che la sposa, Giulia, scappi via proprio sulla sua Vespa dieci minuti prima della cerimonia. Inizia una fuga folle per tutta l'Italia, tra cene a base di pasta, tramonti mozzafiato e la scoperta che forse il vero amore non è quello dei film, ma quello che trovi quando non lo cerchi.

hero.name: Luca
hero.description: Un fotografo di matrimoni affascinante ma sfortunato in amore. Viaggia su una Vespa azzurra e ha un talento per trovarsi sempre nel posto sbagliato al momento giusto.

localized.vision_en: A wedding photographer races across Italy after a runaway bride, managing stress, career reputation, personal feelings, and the search for a defining photograph.
localized.vision_zh: 一名婚礼摄影师追随逃跑新娘横穿意大利，同时管理压力、职业声誉、个人感情，并寻找决定性的照片。

source_record.title: L'Étranger du Warp
source_record.description: Vous incarnez Christian, un space marine psyker projeté dans un monde médiéval fantastique. Inscrivez-vous à la guilde des aventuriers, choisissez votre classe et votre alignement, puis bâtissez votre réputation à travers quêtes, alliances et conquêtes. Votre équipement futuriste et vos pouvoirs psy suscitent crainte et fascination.
source_record.theme: Un guerrier surgi d'un autre univers doit bâtir sa renommée dans un royaume médiéval fantastique, en conciliant ses pouvoirs étranges avec les règles de la guilde des aventuriers.

hero.name: Christian
hero.description: Un space marine psyker, massif et augmenté, vêtu d'une armure noire ornée de symboles impériaux. Ses yeux bleus luisent d'une énergie warp. Il maîtrise des pouvoirs psychiques et un équipement futuriste, mais il doit repartir de zéro dans ce monde médiéval.

Na cidade portuária de Porto Sombra, poder não se herda — conquista-se. Gangues dominam bairros inteiros, políticos corruptos compram lealdade com dinheiro sujo e cada esquina pode ser o início de uma aliança… ou de uma guerra. Você começa como apenas mais um nome nas ruas, mas cada decisão pode aumentar sua reputação: controlando territórios, formando alianças improváveis, traindo rivais ou acumulando riqueza e influência.

Não existe um final para essa história. Em Porto Sombra, o jogo continua enquanto você sobreviver. Quanto mais ousadas forem suas ações, mais rápido seu nome sobe no ranking da cidade. source_record.theme:
From the game Horizon Zero Dawn and related media. 

Set in a lush, vibrant, post-apocalyptic Earth reclaimed by nature, centuries after a mysterious cataclysm destroyed modern civilization. Humanity has regressed to primitive, warring tribes—such as the deeply superstitious Nora, the sun-worshipping Carja, and the metal-working Oseram. The dominant species are now massive, highly advanced robotic beasts that resemble dinosaurs and ancient megafauna (like Watchers, Sabertooths, and massive Thunderjaws). Recently, the machines have become increasingly aggressive, a phenomenon known as "The Derangement," and deadly "corrupted" machines are spreading like a plague. The player, as Aloy, must venture beyond the Sacred Lands. She will hunt enormous mechanical beasts using tripcasters and elemental arrows, override their systems to mount them, and navigate complex tribal politics. Her ultimate quest is to uncover the truth of "Project Zero Dawn," battle a militant cult called the Eclipse led by the ruthless Helis, and stop an ancient, world-ending rogue AI named HADES from wiping out life on Earth a second time.

Raised in the harsh wilderness by her gruff mentor, Rost, she grew up shunned by her people but deeply attuned to the natural world and the deadly robotic creatures that roam it. Armed with a specialized hunter bow, a spear, and an ancient augmented-reality device called a "Focus" attached to her ear, she is highly resourceful, athletic, and fiercely independent. Driven by a lifelong mystery regarding her true origins and the mother she never knew, Aloy is pragmatic, curious, and empathetic. She uses her tactical intellect to take down machines ten times her size while searching for answers in the metal ruins of the "Old Ones."

source_record.title: Humanity's Fade
source_record.description: You are Daniel Hale, navigating a city silenced by an alien harvest. The invaders are tall, light-absorbing entities that treat humans as resources. You must survive by scavenging, moving silently, and managing your dwindling supplies and sanity. Encounter other survivors whose desperation or transformation makes them as dangerous as the invaders themselves. Every choice affects your survival and your remaining humanity.
source_record.theme:
It began without warning.

The sky fractured with silent shapes that swallowed the stars. Power failed across continents in minutes. Cities fell dark. Communications died. And then they came.

The invaders do not resemble anything Earth ever knew. Their forms are tall, unnatural, and wrong — limbs too long, joints bending in impossible ways. Their surfaces reflect no light, absorbing the world around them. Their eyes — if they can be called eyes — glow faintly with a cold intelligence that does not see humans as enemies… only as resources.

They move slowly, deliberately, without panic or hesitation. They do not shout. They do not rage. They simply take.

Entire populations vanish overnight.

Now the city lies broken. Glass towers stand hollow. Streets are filled with abandoned vehicles and drifting ash. The air hums with distant mechanical tones that seem to pulse beneath the ground itself.

You are still here.

You don’t know why.

You don’t know how long.

Every sound matters. Every decision could reveal your presence. Every encounter could be your last.

You will search for shelter. You will scavenge what remains. You will encounter others — some desperate, some dangerous, some no longer entirely human.

And the invaders are still watching.

They are still searching.

They are still harvesting.

Humanity is fading.

But you are not gone yet.

And as long as you remain, the story is not over.

source_record.theme:
Marcus Alvarez grew up in the shadow of freeway overpasses and burned-out liquor stores. Quiet, observant, and patient, he learned early that the loudest people rarely survive long in this city. Known on the streets as “Rook,” he plays the long game — watching, waiting, striking when everyone else thinks the board is safe.

Rook isn’t the strongest fighter or the richest hustler in Los Reyes, but he understands power. He studies people, weaknesses, alliances, and timing. His calm presence hides a ruthless streak: once someone crosses him, he never forgets.

Scarred knuckles, a worn leather jacket, and a steady stare that unnerves even hardened criminals — Rook moves through the city like he already owns it.

But right now he owns nothing.

In Los Reyes, reputation is everything.
And tonight, Rook begins building his.

source_record.description: Operate in the Lost Time between frames to save a reality that is being deleted by the Null-Route.
source_record.theme:
Updated Story Outline: "The Desync Chronicles"
The Hook: In a world where heroes are ranked by their "Uptime" (their ability to stay active and visible), the public has become addicted to the seamlessness of hero society. But a underground faction known as The Null-Route has discovered a way to weaponize the "gaps" in reality—the split seconds between a thought and a muscle movement.

The Inciting Incident: During a televised hero exam, a massive "Desync" occurs. To the cameras, it looks like a hero missed a simple save. In reality, the villain group has deployed a Temporal Jammer. While the "powerhouse" heroes are stuck moving in slow-motion—trapped in a 10-second delay—Kaito realizes his "Frame Rate" Quirk allows him to operate in the "Lost Time."

The Rising Action: Kaito is recruited by a clandestine unit of the Hero Academy called The Debuggers. While the flashy heroes handle the PR and the street-level thugs, Kaito’s team operates in the "Lag-Zones" created by villains. He has to balance his life as a "low-tier" student by day and a high-speed "System Administrator" of reality by night.

The Climax: The leader of The Null-Route, a villain who can "Delete" moments of history, attempts to erase the city's memory of the Top Hero to collapse society. Kaito has to enter a Max Overclock state, pushing his body to 1000 FPS to "re-write" the missing moments faster than the villain can delete them.

hero.name: Kaito Arisawa
hero.description:
Title: The Kinetic Efficiency Hero

Character Description
Kaito is a lean, athletic young man with messy, "static-charged" white hair that floats slightly off his scalp. His most striking feature is a set of digital-style HUD rings that glow in his irises when his power is active.

The Suit: A sleek, pressurized bodysuit made of impact-resistant carbon fiber. It features copper "heat sinks" along the spine and limbs to dissipate the massive thermal energy his body generates. He wears high-tech goggles that help him process information at high speeds.

The Quirk: "Frame Rate"
Kaito can perceive and move through the world at different "frame rates."

How it works: He doesn't technically stop time; he accelerates his own biological and neurological processing speed. To others, he looks like he’s teleporting or moving in "glitchy" bursts.

The Drawback: His body still experiences the friction and G-force of that speed. If he "overclocks" for too long, his internal temperature skyrockets, leading to muscle tears or systemic shut down. He has to literally "cool down" between bursts.
