source_record.title: Gladiator: The Roar of Aurelia
source_record.description: You are Cassian Valerius, a man stripped of his land and forced into the bloody sands of the Aurelian Arena. You must navigate the brutal hierarchy of the gladiator pits, balance the fickle adoration of the masses with the cold demands of your Lanista, and survive the steel of rivals. Every scar tells a story, and every victory brings you closer to the Emperor's favor—or a shallow grave. The sand is thirsty; will you feed it with your blood or your glory?
source_record.theme:
Once a farmer’s son, now a chained gladiator in the empire’s greatest arena. Scarred but unbroken, Cassian fights not just for survival, but for a chance at freedom — and the roar of a crowd that could turn a slave into a legend.

Story Description:
Thrown into the brutal sands of Aurelia’s arena, you must battle rival gladiators, earn the crowd’s favor, and navigate the dangerous politics behind the spectacle. Every victory builds your fame. Every defeat could be your last. Will you win glory, freedom, or ignite something far greater than a fight for survival?

hero.name: Cassian Valerius
hero.description: A tough roman man

localized.vision_en: A dispossessed fighter rises through a brutal arena hierarchy, balancing public favor, patron demands, rival combatants, and the price of freedom.
localized.vision_zh: 一名失去土地的斗士在残酷竞技场等级中崛起，平衡观众支持、主办者要求、对手和自由的代价。

source_record.title: Витя: Матерный Апокалипсис
source_record.description: Вы играете за Витю, сантехника из ЖЭКа, который оказался в эпицентре криминального и космического пиздеца. Вам нужно балансировать между уровнем розыска полицией, зарядом инопланетной хреновины и попытками не сойти с ума от претензий бывшей жены. Используйте матерные команды для активации устройства, прячьте чемодан в самых злачных местах города и постарайтесь не допустить, чтобы инопланетный вирус превратил ваш родной Затупинск в филиал ада, пока вы ищете, где бы выпить и закусить.
source_record.theme: Витя случайно находит в подвале хрущевки чемодан с деньгами коррумпированного мэра и... инопланетное устройство, которое исполняет желания, но понимает только матерные команды. Теперь Вите нужно и деньги спрятать, и город от апокалипсиса спасти, попутно отбиваясь от бандитов, «мусоров» и собственной бывшей жены, которая хочет алименты. Весь сюжет — это череда нецензурных приключений, где главный враг не злодеи, а тупость окружающих и вечное русское «авось».

hero.name: Витя
hero.description: Сотрудник управляющей компании (ЖЭКа) в депрессивном промышленном городе. Витя — философ с разводным ключом, который видел в этой жизни всё. Его лексикон на 70% состоит из виртуозного мата, который он использует как для общения, так и для ремонта труб.

localized.vision_en: A plumber caught between crime and an alien outbreak manages pursuit, a volatile device, family pressure, and the survival of his hometown.
localized.vision_zh: 一名水管工卷入犯罪与外星疫情，必须同时处理追捕、危险装置、家庭压力和家乡存亡。

source_record.title: Los Reyes: Rue de l'Ombre
source_record.description: Vous êtes Marcus “Rook” Alvarez, un homme des rues de Los Reyes qui grimpe dans le milieu par la réputation. Naviguez les gangs, trahisons et opportunités pour bâtir votre légende. Chaque choix impacte votre réputation, santé et ressources dans cette ville impitoyable. Soyez méthodique ou brutal — les rues jugent.
source_record.theme:
Los Reyes est une vaste ville de la côte Ouest où le pouvoir change de mains chaque nuit. Les riches vivent dans des tours de verre au-dessus du smog tandis que les rues en bas sont contrôlées par des gangs, des contrebandiers, des politiciens corrompus et des syndicats qui gèrent les docks et les boîtes de nuit.

Personne ne règne plus sur la ville.

Les anciennes familles criminelles se sont effondrées après une répression sanglante des fédéraux il y a des années, laissant les quartiers fracturés et les leaders paranoïaques. Les petits opérateurs se disputent les territoires tandis que les gros joueurs préparent discrètement leurs prochains coups.

Les rumeurs disent qu'un nouveau arrive — quelqu'un de méthodique, patient.

Quelqu'un qui sait que le vrai pouvoir n'est ni les armes ni l'argent.

C'est la réputation.

Dans ce monde, chaque mouvement compte.

Prenez le contrôle d'une boîte de nuit et les gens commencent à parler.
Gérez la protection d'un bloc et les rivaux le remarquent.
Humiliez le mauvais boss et toute la ville pourrait se retourner contre vous.

Chaque job, alliance, trahison et confrontation gagne ou coûte de la réputation.

Et la réputation se répand plus vite que les balles.

Certains bâtissent des empires par la loyauté et les deals prudents.
D'autres brûlent leur chemin jusqu'au sommet par l'intimidation et le chaos.

Les rues de Los Reyes regardent.

Parce que dans cette ville, les légendes ne naissent pas.

Elles se font dans l'asphalte, le sang et l'ambition.

Un seul nom dominera le milieu.

Ce sera le vôtre ?

hero.name: Marcus “Rook” Alvarez
hero.description: Un homme maigre d'une trentaine d'années à la peau hâlée par le soleil, yeux bruns perçants et une fine cicatrice sur le sourcil droit. Cheveux courts noirs souvent cachés sous une casquette noire usée, barbe de trois jours sur la mâchoire. Il porte une veste en cuir fanée, tee-shirt blanc simple, jeans sombres et bottes éraflées. Son regard calme et sa confiance silencieuse mettent les gens mal à l'aise — l'air d'un type des rues qui observe tout.

localized.vision_en: A calculating operator rises through a ruthless city by navigating gangs, betrayals, and opportunities while reputation, health, and resources remain fragile.
localized.vision_zh: 一名精于算计的行动者在残酷城市中周旋帮派、背叛与机会，而声望、健康和资源始终脆弱。

source_record.title: Iron Streets Empire
source_record.description: You are Arthur Hale, a war veteran carving out power in post-war Birmingham's gang wars. Navigate razor gangs, corrupt cops, and rival bookies to build your feared reputation on the iron streets. Every choice risks blood, betrayal, or breakthrough.
source_record.theme: England, 1919. The war has ended, but the streets are still full of soldiers who never truly came home. Factories choke the sky with smoke, money flows through betting houses and pubs, and every alley in Birmingham hides a gang looking to carve out its own empire. The old criminal families once ruled the streets, but the war shattered their power. Now the city is a battlefield of bookmakers, smugglers, dock workers, and razor gangs fighting for control of the iron streets. Police patrols grow more aggressive, politicians whisper behind closed doors, and new opportunities appear wherever money and desperation meet. Arthur Hale returned from the war with nothing but his instincts and a reputation for surviving impossible situations. But in a city like Birmingham, survival is not enough. Control the betting houses. Build alliances with dangerous men. Outmaneuver rival gangs and corrupt officials. Because in this city, power belongs to the gang whose name everyone fears to say out loud. And the iron streets are waiting for their new king.

hero.name: Arthur Hale
hero.description: A tall, lean man in his early 30s with pale skin, sharp cheekbones, and cold grey eyes that miss nothing. His dark hair is neatly parted beneath a worn flat cap, and a thin scar cuts across one eyebrow. He dresses in a long wool coat over a waistcoat and rolled-sleeve shirt, the style of a man who works the streets but carries himself like he already owns them.

localized.vision_en: A war veteran builds power in a postwar industrial city, navigating razor gangs, corrupt officials, rival bookmakers, and unstable loyalties.
localized.vision_zh: 一名退伍军人在战后工业城市建立势力，周旋于刀锋帮派、腐败官员、竞争庄家与不稳定忠诚。

source_record.title: Descent to the World Heart
source_record.description: You are Kael Ardent, a disgraced geologist obsessed with the Earth's hidden truths. Seismic cataclysms tear the world apart, revealing an ancient abyss. Lead your team into the depths, manage scarce resources, confront lost ecosystems and ancient horrors, and uncover the failing World Heart machine before the planet resets and wipes out humanity. Survival demands caution, planning, and tough choices amid escalating dangers.
source_record.theme:
When a chain of impossible seismic events begins reshaping continents overnight, the world panics. Mountains split. Oceans withdraw. Entire cities vanish into sudden sinkholes. Scientists declare it planetary instability — but Kael sees a pattern.

Ancient texts across cultures — Mayan, Norse, Vedic — all speak of a “World Heart,” a living core that sustains the surface realm. If it weakens, the world fractures. If it awakens… it reshapes.

A colossal abyss opens in the Arctic ice — perfectly circular, impossibly deep. Against global orders, Kael assembles a rogue team: a combat engineer, a linguist of forgotten myth, and a former special forces climber. Their descent reveals not molten rock — but ecosystems lost to time. Bioluminescent forests growing from cavern ceilings. Floating landmasses suspended by magnetic storms. Ancient creatures adapted to crushing gravity and eternal darkness.

But deeper still lies something worse.

An ancient civilization — older than humanity — built a machine around the planet’s core. A machine designed not to protect the Earth… but to control its evolution. And it is failing.

As Kael descends toward the molten cathedral at the center, he learns the truth: The surface world is only one phase of the Earth’s cycle. Every few millennia, the planet “resets.” Continents sink. Species vanish. New ages begin.

This time, humanity is scheduled for extinction.

hero.name: Kael Ardent
hero.description: A disgraced geologist turned expedition leader, Kael is driven by obsession rather than fame. Broad-shouldered, scarred from a prior cave-in, and carrying a brass compass that never points north, he believes the Earth is not hollow — it is alive. Haunted by tremors that only he seems to sense, Kael is determined to descend where no civilization has survived.

localized.vision_en: A disgraced geologist leads a team through a newly opened abyss, managing scarce resources and ancient ecosystems before a planetary machine resets Earth.
localized.vision_zh: 一名失势地质学家带队深入新出现的深渊，在行星机器重置地球前管理稀缺资源并面对古老生态。

source_record.title: Echoes of the Void Gate
source_record.description: Navigate the endless void, step through enigmatic gates, solve their riddles, and uncover the lost histories of dwarven craftsmanship, elven battles, and restless spirits, while piecing together the vessel's forgotten purpose.
source_record.theme: A wandering vessel drifts through a black void, entering dimension gates that lead to fractured worlds of ancient dwarven forges, elven wars, and lingering spirits, each gate a puzzle reflecting fragments of the hero's own soul.

hero.name: you
hero.description: a discarded vessel yet to find their true meaning, purpose and journey in this God forsaken void of endless stories

localized.vision_en: An explorer crosses enigmatic gates in an endless void, solves their riddles, and reconstructs a forgotten vessel's purpose from lost cultures.
localized.vision_zh: 一名探索者穿过无尽虚空中的神秘门户、解决谜题，并从失落文明遗迹中重建遗忘飞船的用途。

source_record.title: La Santa de las Nubes
source_record.description: Eres Lucía 'La Santa', una ex-sicaria con un brazo de oro y una IA en los nervios. Te mueves por los niveles de una CDMX que rasca el cielo, cargando el chip que las corporaciones matarían por borrar. Cada paso hacia arriba es una guerra. Usa tu instinto, tu cromo y tu puntería para llegar a la cima antes de que los Mariachis Negros te encuentren.
source_record.theme: En una Ciudad de México vertical que llega hasta las nubes, Lucía roba un chip de datos que contiene las conciencias digitales de los antiguos líderes revolucionarios. Ahora, perseguida por drones-mariachi y asesinos modificados, debe subir al nivel más alto de la ciudad para transmitir la verdad y provocar una rebelión digital.

hero.name: Lucía "La Santa"
hero.description: Una ex-sicaria convertida en mercenaria. Tiene un brazo robótico decorado con oro y grabados de la Santa Muerte. Su sistema nervioso está conectado a una IA que le permite predecir los movimientos de sus enemigos en cámara lenta.

localized.vision_en: A former operative with a golden arm climbs a vertical megacity carrying a forbidden chip while corporations and elite hunters close in.
localized.vision_zh: 一名拥有金色义臂的前行动人员携带禁忌芯片攀登垂直巨城，同时躲避企业和精英猎手追杀。

source_record.title: Bunnyverse Descent
source_record.description: You are an Isekai'd human trapped in the Bunnyverse. Navigate its dangerous regions, interact with strange factions, and try to escape back to reality while surviving the influence of Wills.
source_record.theme:
The Bunnyverse is a boundless dimension composes of various regions; The Freak Forests, Eggtopia the land of the Easter Bunnies, the incest hills of the Gnarled Warrens, the peaceful Warrens beneath an active construction zone, and the long eldritch desert of Bunnyspace, where the corpses of ancient dead gods make tall skyscrapers and monuments to rot. Hamster Hell is one of many pocket locations, where hamsters' suicidal tendencies are amplified, yet they cannot die. 

In the Bunnyverse, multiple factions are at play; The Presidents of the United States, Isekai'd and attempting to rule from below. The Chosen Jews, a Zionist cult of Jewish influence. The Freak Faction, a guild of perverts, cuckolds, and sadists. The Knights of the Down Table, a bunch of down syndrome men who try to make the world a better place through their bumbling. The Easter Bunnies, the rabbits of the Warrens, Balthazaar's Mafia, and the Warren of the Willful who venerate the evil powerful bunny demigod wizard Wills, and all manner of other guilds and factions make their home in this land.

John Smith is brought to this will and subject to the influence of Wills, yet is pursued by the redeeming heroic figure Jesus Christ, who crossed into the Bunnyverse to try to cure his twisted perversions. Players are fellow Isekai'd human beings in the bunnyverse who try to influence the events of the world in a desperate bid to escape it, and return to their reality.

hero.name: John Smith, the Bunny Overlord
hero.description: A balding, fat, middle aged perverted man with a bunny costume and a used diaper overtop of it loses his mind and becomes a serial killer after his last shift at Subway. He becomes Isekai'd into a personal hell, where he seeks power and domination within the Bunnyverse.

localized.vision_en: A stranded human crosses dangerous regions of a strange rabbit realm, negotiates with eccentric factions, and resists a corrupting influence while seeking escape.
localized.vision_zh: 一名被困人类穿越奇异兔界的危险区域，与古怪派系谈判，并在寻找出口时抵抗腐化影响。

source_record.title: I Codici del Volo
source_record.description: Guida Leonardo attraverso una Firenze rinascimentale alternativa piena di ingranaggi e intrighi. Usa la tua astuzia e le tue invenzioni per superare le guardie e i cospiratori. Ogni scelta influenza la tua notorietà e la sicurezza dei Codici.
source_record.theme: Quando il Gran Maestro dell'Accademia viene assassinato con un'arma impossibile, Leo scopre un complotto per rubare i "Codici del Volo". Usando prototipi di ali meccaniche e bombe fumogene alchemiche, Leo deve scappare sui tetti di Firenze per proteggere l'ultima invenzione che potrebbe cambiare la guerra per sempre.

hero.name: Leonardo
hero.description: Un giovane apprendista geniale con un braccio meccanico di sua invenzione. Porta sempre con sé un taccuino pieno di schemi e una borsa di attrezzi in ottone.

localized.vision_en: An inventor crosses an alternate Renaissance city of gears and intrigue, using prototypes and stealth to protect stolen flight designs from conspirators.
localized.vision_zh: 一名发明家穿越充满齿轮与阴谋的架空文艺复兴城市，利用原型机与潜行保护被窃取的飞行设计。

source_record.title: Aethelgard: The Runic Fist
source_record.description: You are Arcand, a warrior whose very skin is etched with the fading power of a lost age. Every time you channel the runes on your arms to protect Aethelgard, you lose a piece of your memory or your life force. You must navigate the tension between the Ivory Watchers, the machine-driven Iron Alliance, and the fanatical Chisel Cult while searching for a way to stabilize the world before your own light flickers out.
source_record.theme:
Aethelgard é um mundo de beleza melancólica, onde o céu purpúreo e as florestas de ferro guardam os restos da Era do Silêncio. Após a destruição dos pilares rúnicos, a magia tornou-se uma relíquia perigosa que exige o sacrifício da vitalidade e das memórias de quem a porta. Nesse cenário, a ordem dos Vigilantes de Marfim luta para preservar o equilíbrio, agindo como guardiões das últimas pedras rúnicas que mantêm o clima estável, enquanto enfrentam a oposição radical do Culto do Cinzel, que caça portadores de runas, e da Aliança de Ferro, que busca erradicar a magia em favor das máquinas.
No centro deste conflito está Arcand, um Guerreiro Rúnico e antigo membro dos Vigilantes, que carrega no corpo o conhecimento de uma linhagem quase extinta. Sua jornada é marcada por figuras complexas: como Valerius, um ex-aliado que se tornou um carrasco obcecado por colecionar glifos, e a jovem Elara, cuja capacidade de interpretar as marcas na pele de Arcand é a única bússola do herói. Entre batalhas e o silêncio das ruínas, Arcand luta contra o tempo, sabendo que cada vez que suas runas brilham, ele protege o mundo ao custo de perder um pedaço de si mesmo.

hero.name: Arcand, o Punho das Runas
hero.description:
Arcand é um homem de estatura imponente, cuja presença física é tão densa quanto a armadura que carrega. Seus cabelos são claros, quase platinados, e caem desalinhados sobre os ombros. O traço mais marcante, porém, são as runas cravadas em sua própria pele: linhas geométricas que partem das mãos e sobem pelos braços até o pescoço.
Olhos: De um cinza profundo que se torna azul luminescente quando ele canaliza energia.
Vestimenta: Uma armadura pesada de placas de ferro escuro, sem ornamentos reais, exceto pelos entalhes rúnicos que brilham em um tom âmbar suave quando ele está em combate.

localized.vision_en: A warrior spends memory or life force whenever ancient runes are used, balancing rival factions while searching for a way to stabilize a fading world.
localized.vision_zh: 一名战士每次使用古老符文都会损失记忆或生命力，必须平衡敌对派系并寻找稳定衰败世界的方法。

source_record.title: เงาแห่งกรุงเทพ
source_record.description: คุณคือเงาแห่งกรุงเทพ ชายหนุ่มที่เริ่มต้นจากศูนย์ในโลกใต้ดินของเมืองหลวง สร้างชื่อเสียงผ่านการต่อรอง ต่อสู้ และสร้างพันธมิตร ท่ามกลางแสงนีออนและเงามืด เลือกเส้นทางของคุณอย่างระมัดระวัง เพราะทุกการตัดสินใจส่งผลต่อชื่อเสียงของคุณ
source_record.theme: กรุงเทพในยามค่ำคืนไม่เคยเงียบจริง ๆ ใต้แสงไฟนีออนของถนนใหญ่และตรอกแคบ ๆ มีโลกอีกใบที่เต็มไปด้วยการต่อรอง อำนาจ และความลับ กลุ่มอิทธิพล นักธุรกิจสีเทา และเครือข่ายใต้ดินต่างแข่งขันกันเพื่อควบคุมพื้นที่ของเมือง คุณเริ่มต้นจากคนธรรมดา ไม่มีชื่อเสียง ไม่มีอำนาจ แต่ในโลกนี้ ชื่อเสียงคือทุกอย่าง ทุกงานที่คุณรับ ทุกพันธมิตรที่คุณสร้าง และทุกศัตรูที่คุณล้มลง จะทำให้ชื่อของคุณแพร่กระจายไปทั่วเครือข่ายใต้ดินของกรุงเทพ

hero.name: กิตติพงษ์ “กิต” ศิริชัย
hero.description: ชายวัย 30 ปี รูปร่างผอมแข็งแรง ผิวแทนจากชีวิตกลางคืน ดวงตาคมกริบและระวังตัวเสมอ ผมดำตัดสั้นด้านข้าง มีรอยแผลเล็กๆ ที่คิ้ว สวมแจ็คเก็ตหนังเข้ม เสื้อเชิ้ตเรียบ กางเกงทรงslim และบูทดำ ท่าทางสงบแต่แฝงความระมัดระวังจากประสบการณ์ในโลกใต้ดิน

localized.vision_en: A newcomer builds an underworld reputation in neon Bangkok through negotiation, combat, alliances, and careful responses to every consequence.
localized.vision_zh: 一名新人在霓虹曼谷通过谈判、战斗、联盟和谨慎应对后果建立地下声望。

source_record.title: Trần Khoa: Huyền Thoại Đường Phố
source_record.description: Bạn là Trần Khoa, một thanh niên bình thường với một bí mật phi thường: một Hệ Thống thăng cấp trong thế giới ngầm đầy rẫy bạo lực của Sài Gòn. Hãy điều hướng qua những âm mưu của các băng đảng, chiến đấu để sinh tồn và quyết định xem bạn sẽ dùng sức mạnh của mình để bảo vệ hay để thống trị.
source_record.theme: Trần Khoa grew up in the crowded streets of Ho Chi Minh City, overlooked and underestimated. When he stumbles into an underground fighting network where strength determines survival, he discovers a hidden system that allows him to grow stronger with every battle. What begins as survival becomes transformation. Fame, power, and enemies await — but every victory changes who he is. He can rise to become a legend — or lose himself completely.

hero.name: Trần Khoa
hero.description: Trần Khoa grew up in the crowded streets of Ho Chi Minh City, overlooked and underestimated

localized.vision_en: A young man with a hidden progression system navigates a violent city underworld and chooses whether new power will protect others or dominate them.
localized.vision_zh: 一名拥有隐藏成长系统的青年周旋于暴力都市地下世界，并决定新力量将用于保护他人还是统治他人。

source_record.title: Santa Ceniza: El Eco del Olvido
source_record.description: Te encuentras en la entrada de Santa Ceniza. El aire huele a polvo antiguo y a flores secas. Los habitantes, tanto vivos como muertos, repiten sus rutinas bajo un cielo gris que nunca cambia. Tu misión es romper el ciclo. Debes encontrar la Flor del Olvido, oculta en las entrañas de este lugar maldito, antes de que el eco colonial consuma tu propia alma.
source_record.theme: En el pueblo de Santa Ceniza, el tiempo se ha detenido y los muertos caminan entre los vivos como si nada. Mateo debe encontrar la "Flor del Olvido" para que su pueblo pueda finalmente morir en paz y liberarse de una maldición colonial que los condena a repetir el mismo día por la eternidad.

hero.name: Mateo
hero.description: Mateo "El Olvidado", Un hombre de piel curtida por el sol que viste un poncho desgarrado que cambia de color según su estado de ánimo. Lleva un machete que puede cortar las sombras y un frasco con suspiros que usa para curar heridas.

localized.vision_en: A traveler enters a cursed town where living and dead repeat routines, seeking a hidden flower before the colonial echo consumes another soul.
localized.vision_zh: 一名旅人进入生者与死者重复日常的诅咒小镇，必须在殖民回声吞噬灵魂前找到隐藏之花。

source_record.title: Thorgal e la Tempesta dei LED
source_record.description: Guida Thorgal attraverso un mondo dove la natura ha vinto. Recupera i preziosi frammenti di luce che cadono dal cielo durante le tempeste. Usa la tua astuzia per superare le trappole di Baldur e riportare la speranza alla tua gente. Ogni scelta determinerà se la luce tornerà a splendere o se il mondo rimarrà nell'oscurità.
source_record.theme: Mondo post-apocalittico la natura domina, tempeste di luci led che piovono dal cielo, non c' è più elettricità ma esistono i cacciatori di led come Thorgal. Il suo acerrimo nemico si chiama Baldur caccia, ruba e ottiene i suoi led nei modi più illeciti per poi rivenderli a chi non riesce a procurarsene a prezzi e scambi esorbitanti.

hero.name: Thorgal
hero.description: ragazzino di 13 anni bruno con occhi grandi, snello e muscoloso, molto intelligente, molto curioso e sognatore.

localized.vision_en: A survivor crosses a world reclaimed by nature, gathers luminous fragments during storms, avoids traps, and decides whether light can return.
localized.vision_zh: 一名幸存者穿越被自然重新占据的世界，在风暴中收集发光碎片、避开陷阱，并决定光明能否回归。

source_record.title: Sombras de Camelot
source_record.description: Construye tu reputación en Camelot mientras navegas la guerra de sucesión, intrigas políticas y amenazas ocultas.
source_record.theme: Una nación europea secreta domina el mundo con magia industrializada mientras lucha por la sucesión del trono y el control del sello divino.

hero.name: Kaizer Pendragon
hero.description: Kaizer es el octavo hijo de Cornelius Pendragon, nacido fuera del matrimonio. Su sangre contiene la esencia más pura del dragón Vermithor, otorgándole un fuego latente que aún no comprende.

localized.vision_en: An ambitious figure builds reputation during a succession war, navigating court intrigue, territorial claims, and supernatural threats around a legendary capital.
localized.vision_zh: 一名野心家在王位继承战争中积累声望，周旋宫廷阴谋、领地争夺和传奇都城周围的超自然威胁。

source_record.title: Shadows of Firenze
source_record.description: You are Matteo da Firenze, a vengeful Assassin in 1478 Florence. Use stealth, parkour, and cunning to hunt Templars amid gritty streets and opulent courts. Blend into crowds, eavesdrop, pickpocket clues, and strike from rooftops. Allies like Leonardo and Mario aid your quest to stop the Piece of Eden's unearthing.
source_record.theme: The world is a gritty, historically accurate recreation of 1478 Florence, Italy, secretly torn apart by an ancient, invisible war: The Assassin Brotherhood, who fight for free will, versus the Templar Order, who demand absolute control. The player is Matteo, a newly initiated Assassin navigating both the dangerous, poverty-stricken slums and the opulent, heavily guarded palaces of the ruling elite. Aided by a brilliant but eccentric young inventor named Leonardo da Vinci and a rugged mercenary leader named Mario, Matteo must hunt down a list of elite Templar conspirators, including members of the ruthless Pazzi family and the shadowy Rodrigo Borgia. The player will use social stealth to blend into dense crowds, gather information through pickpocketing and eavesdropping, and execute rooftop assassinations. The ultimate goal is to dismantle the Templar network and stop them from unearthing an ancient, mind-controlling Precursor artifact known as the "Piece of Eden" buried somewhere beneath the city streets.

hero.name: Matteo da Firenze
hero.description: Once the carefree son of a minor noble house, Matteo’s life was shattered when his family was falsely accused of treason and executed by a corrupt syndicate known as the Templar Order. Forced to flee into the grimy underbelly of 15th-century Florence, Matteo traded his velvet cloaks for a shadowed hood and a hidden blade strapped to his wrist. He is agile, cynical, and driven by a thirst for justice. To survive the harsh realities of city living, he relies on a network of thieves, mercenaries, and courtesans. He uses his mastery of parkour and free-running to turn the city's rooftops into his personal highway, silently hunting the men who destroyed his family.

localized.title_zh: 文艺复兴佛罗伦萨暗影
localized.vision_en: A rooftop operative uses stealth, parkour, crowds, and stolen clues to expose a secret order manipulating politics in Renaissance Florence.
localized.vision_zh: 一名屋顶行动者在文艺复兴佛罗伦萨利用潜行、跑酷、人群与窃取线索，揭露操纵政治的秘密组织。

source_record.title: Duke Nukem: Alien Asskicker
source_record.description: You are Duke Nukem, Earth's badass defender against alien scum. Chew bubblegum and kick ass through mutated city ruins and invader strongholds. Track health, ammo, rage, and tech while collecting weapons to blast the alien overlord.
source_record.theme:
Duke Nuke'Em

An alien war fleet suddenly appears in Earth’s orbit and begins deploying strange energy towers across major cities. These devices are draining the planet’s atmosphere and mutating entire districts into hostile alien environments.

You are Duke, the only operative reckless enough to storm alien strongholds alone. Armed with experimental weapons and an arsenal that would make most generals nervous, you fight through neon-lit city ruins, alien fortresses, and underground invasion hubs.

Each mission reveals more about the invaders’ true goal: Earth isn’t just being conquered—it’s being transformed into something unrecognizable. The deeper you push into their war machine, the closer you get to the alien overlord directing the invasion from orbit.

Whether you save Earth or blow half of it up in the process… well, that’s up to you.

hero.name: Duke Nukem
hero.description: Duke is a loud-mouthed Earth Defense commando famous for blowing up alien war machines and walking away from the explosions without a scratch. Wearing mirrored shades and carrying enough firepower to level a city block, Rex doesn’t negotiate with invaders—he removes them. Beneath the bravado, however, he’s the one soldier willing to charge headfirst into impossible fights to protect humanity.

localized.vision_en: A brash defender battles through mutated city ruins and invader strongholds, managing health, ammunition, rage, and an expanding arsenal.
localized.vision_zh: 一名强悍守卫者穿过变异城市废墟与入侵者堡垒，管理生命、弹药、怒气和不断扩展的武器库。

source_record.title: Progetto Etna: Il Codice Verde
source_record.description: Guida Aris attraverso le strade sporche di una Sicilia distopica. Usa le tue dita enzimatiche per riprogrammare la vita e fermare la Omnicorp. Il tempo scorre, il virus avanza. Ogni tocco conta.
source_record.theme: Un virus sintetico sta uccidendo le "Città-Giardino" della Sicilia. Aris scopre che il virus è stato creato da una multinazionale per costringere le persone a comprare un nuovo tipo di corpo sintetico. Per creare l'antidoto, Aris deve sintetizzare il DNA di una pianta mitologica che si dice cresca solo nel cratere dell'Etna, protetta da guardiani geneticamente modificati.

hero.name: Aris
hero.description: Un bio-ingegnere ribelle con dita lunghe e sensibili cariche di enzimi manipolatori. Può "riprogrammare" il DNA degli esseri viventi con un tocco.

localized.vision_en: A bioengineer crosses a dystopian island, rewrites living systems with enzymatic tools, and races to stop a virus and its controlling corporation.
localized.vision_zh: 一名生物工程师穿越反乌托邦岛屿，使用酶工具重写生命系统，并争分夺秒阻止病毒及控制它的企业。

source_record.title: NEXUS-9: The Stack
source_record.description: You are Mike, a ghost in the machine of Nexus-9. Once a corporate 'problem solver' for Axiom Industries, you were legally deleted after refusing to purge a residential block. Now, with a neural backdoor in your skull and no legal identity, you must survive the vertical sprawl of The Stack. Navigate the neon-drenched Understack, avoid the algorithmic sentencing of corporate drones, and decide if you will remain a ghost or become the glitch that crashes the system.
source_record.theme:
THE WORLD
The City: NEXUS-9
(Known on the street as “The Stack”)
A coastal megacity that never stops growing upward because it has nowhere left to expand outward. The lower levels are drowned in pollution, crime, and forgotten people. The upper levels live in filtered air and curated reality.
The city is owned, not governed.
Corporations replaced nations decades ago. Laws exist, but they’re written in licensing agreements and enforced by automated systems.
SOCIAL STRUCTURE
The Vertical Divide
The Crown (Upper Levels)
Corporate executives, shareholders, and “certified humans.”
Real sunlight. Clean water. Legal identities.
Crime here is rare—and expensive.
Mid-Stack
Office drones, engineers, contract workers.
Constant surveillance. Mandatory productivity implants.
One missed quota away from being demoted to the lower levels.
The Understack
Street-level sprawl of neon, rust, and rain.
Power theft, illegal cyberware, black markets.
Most residents are technically dead—no ID, no rights.
The Sink
Flooded lowest levels where the ocean pushed back.
Sunken streets, half-lit slums, and forgotten infrastructure.
Home to scavengers, rogue AIs, and people who disappeared “by mistake.”
Mike lives between Understack and The Sink.
TECHNOLOGY & CONTROL
The Net (aka The Veil)
An always-on augmented reality layer injected directly into optic implants.
Ads appear in your vision
Faces auto-tag with threat ratings
“Reality filters” hide poverty in richer zones
Opting out is illegal without a corporate exemption
Mike’s HUD glitches—he sometimes sees what the Veil is trying to hide.
Corporate Governance
No police force in the traditional sense.
Instead:
Compliance Drones
Contract Enforcers
Algorithmic Sentencing (your sentence is calculated before you’re arrested)
Mike used to work for one of these systems.
MAJOR FACTIONS
Axiom Industries
Mike’s former employer.
Data control, predictive policing, behavioral modeling
Owns the Veil’s core architecture
Their slogan: “Stability is Freedom.”
They want Mike back—either alive or permanently offline.
Helix Bioworks
Body augmentation, gene editing, memory modification.
Their clinics look clean, but their experiments leak into the streets
Rumored to be growing replacement bodies for executives
The Null Saints
A techno-religious underground movement.
Believe humanity ended when consciousness became transferable
Wear signal-jamming cloaks and ritual scars
They help people disappear—for a price
They see Mike as a “fractured soul” and possible omen.
FreeSignal
Decentralized hackers, data smugglers, pirate broadcasters.
Operate out of abandoned transmission towers
Broadcast illegal truth bursts before being shut down
Mike occasionally trades jobs for favors here
KEY LOCATIONS
Neon Cross
The beating heart of the Understack.
Vertical markets
Cyberware chop-shops
Food stalls selling vat-grown everything
Rain never stops—it’s recycled runoff
Mike knows every shadow here.
The Glass Spire
Axiom Industries HQ.
Pierces the clouds
Entire floors restricted to non-physical access
Rumored AI board members
Mike has never looked up at it without feeling sick.
The Floodlines
Submerged transit tunnels and drowned neighborhoods.
Home to scavengers and data divers
Ghost signals echo from dead servers
Some say the Net behaves differently down here
Mike hides things here—including pieces of his past.
Memory Clinics
Run by Helix Bioworks.
You can delete trauma—or implant loyalty
Some patients come out changed
Others don’t come out at all
Mike refuses to enter one.
SUPPORTING CHARACTERS
Iris
FreeSignal operative and pirate broadcaster.
Neon-blue cyber-eyes
Sharp, reckless, idealistic
Believes truth can still change things
She’s the reason Mike keeps getting dragged back into fights.
Calder
Black-market cyberdoc.
Lost both arms in a corporate “equipment failure”
Replaced them with industrial-grade prosthetics
Loyal, but terrified of Axiom
He keeps Mike alive—barely.
Warden-7
An Axiom enforcement AI given physical form.
Speaks calmly while ruining lives
Knows Mike’s psychological profile better than Mike does
Believes reclaiming Mike is merciful
The Child (Name Optional)
An unregistered human—born outside the system.
No Net access
No legal existence
Impossible according to official records
Their existence threatens the entire system.
THEMES & TONE
Identity as a commodity
Memory as a weapon
Survival vs. morality
What counts as “alive” in a synthetic world
The city doesn’t care if you’re good.
It only cares if you’re useful.
Mike is no longer useful—
which makes him dangerous.
If you want next, I can:
Write Chapter One: Opening Scene
Flesh out Axiom’s true endgame
Design a central mystery
Create symbolism & recurring motifs (rain, static, light, etc.)

hero.name: Mike
hero.description:
Mike used to belong to a megacorp program that trained people to be “problem solvers”—corporate ghosts sent to erase liabilities, sabotage rivals, and clean up leaks. He wasn’t a soldier; he was a deniable asset.
During a mission, Mike discovered the target wasn’t a rival exec—but an entire residential block scheduled for deletion to free space for a data-center arcology. The residents were tagged as “statistically irrelevant.”
He refused to finish the job.
The corp didn’t kill him outright—they deleted him legally:
Identity wiped
Bank accounts erased
Medical insurance revoked
Neural backdoor left inside his cyberware
Now he lives in the dead zones of the city, surviving off under-the-table jobs, haunted by what he’s done—and what he failed to stop.

localized.vision_en: A legally erased corporate agent survives a vertical cybercity, avoids algorithmic law enforcement, and decides whether to remain hidden or crash the system.
localized.vision_zh: 一名被法律抹除的企业特工在垂直赛博都市求生，躲避算法执法，并决定继续隐身还是摧毁系统。

source_record.title: Schatten über Berlin
source_record.description: Du bist Erik Neumann, ein Journalist, der zu tief gegraben hat. Navigiere durch das nächtliche Berlin, sammle Beweise und entscheide, wem du in einer Welt voller Schatten und digitaler Spionage trauen kannst.
source_record.theme: A freelance journalist in Berlin who uncovers a story that powerful people want buried. Anonymous messages, surveillance, and hidden networks pull you into a conspiracy. Every decision affects your safety, your career, and the fate of others.

hero.name: Erik Neumann
hero.description: A freelance journalist.

localized.vision_en: A journalist who investigated too deeply crosses nighttime Berlin, gathers evidence, and chooses whom to trust amid digital espionage.
localized.vision_zh: 一名调查过深的记者穿行夜间柏林、搜集证据，并在数字间谍网络中决定相信谁。

source_record.title: 覺醒之城：暗流
source_record.description: 這是一個關於覺醒、陰謀與生存的都市幻想遊戲。林宇辰在現代都市的陰影中探索，必須在崩潰的精神邊緣與虎視眈眈的超自然威脅中取得平衡。
source_record.theme: 你一直過著普通的生活，直到那一夜，時間彷彿停止。城市依舊燈火通明，但你開始看到別人看不到的事物。有人在暗中觀察你，有人知道你的名字，而你的力量正在覺醒。你的選擇將決定你成為守護者，還是被黑暗吞噬。你的命運，現在由你決定。

hero.name: 林宇辰
hero.description: 宇辰一直覺得自己只是這座城市中不起眼的一員。但那一夜之後，一切都改變了。他開始感受到不屬於這個世界的力量。他可以選擇逃避，或是接受命運，成為改變一切的人。

localized.vision_en: A newly awakened resident investigates an urban conspiracy while balancing fragile sanity against predatory supernatural forces.
localized.vision_zh: 一名刚觉醒的居民调查都市阴谋，同时在脆弱理智与虎视眈眈的超自然势力之间维持平衡。

source_record.title: วิถีไอดอล: ปาฏิหาริย์ของนรินทร์
source_record.description: คุณคือนรินทร์ เด็กหนุ่มผู้มีความฝันอันยิ่งใหญ่ในกรุงเทพฯ เริ่มต้นจากการเป็นคนธรรมดาที่ไม่มีเส้นสาย แต่ได้รับโอกาสครั้งสำคัญในการพิสูจน์ตัวเองในอุตสาหกรรมบันเทิง ทุกการตัดสินใจของคุณคือการสร้างตำนานบทใหม่ในโลกที่เต็มไปด้วยแสงสีและการแข่งขันที่ดุเดือด
source_record.theme:
Story Description:
You enter the competitive world of Thailand’s entertainment industry. Attend auditions, training sessions, rehearsals, and live performances across Bangkok. Meet talent scouts, fellow trainees, fans, and rivals who may help or hinder your progress. Your decisions influence your reputation, relationships, and career opportunities. You may rise to become a famous idol, struggle with pressure and competition, or choose a different path entirely. The world reacts dynamically as your career evolves.

⸻

World Setting:
Modern-day Bangkok, including apartments, entertainment agencies, rehearsal studios, night markets, television studios, and performance venues. The environment is grounded in realistic contemporary Thai urban life, with focus on career progression, social relationships, and public recognition.

hero.name: Narin
hero.description: Narin is a young adult living in Bangkok, working ordinary jobs while dreaming of becoming a performer. They live in a small apartment and spend their free time practicing singing and performing. Narin is ambitious, observant, and determined, but has no industry connections. Their life changes when they are unexpectedly invited to audition for a new entertainment agency searching for fresh talent.

localized.vision_en: A Bangkok newcomer enters a fiercely competitive entertainment industry, building skill, relationships, and reputation from a rare first opportunity.
localized.vision_zh: 一名曼谷新人凭借难得机会进入竞争激烈的娱乐行业，从零建立技能、人际关系和声望。

source_record.title: Voice of the Neon Seoul
source_record.description: Help Mina navigate the high-stakes world of K-pop training. Manage her stamina, polish her skills, and make choices that define her path to stardom while staying true to her quiet strength.
source_record.theme: Mina had spent her whole life watching the neon glow of Seoul from her bedroom window, practicing dance routines in secret long after everyone else had fallen asleep. At school she was quiet, invisible even, but in her headphones she was unstoppable — every beat a promise that she could become more than who she was. When she discovers a small audition notice tucked between posters at a local studio, Mina takes a chance, stepping into a world of relentless training, fierce competition, and impossible expectations. Along the way she finds unlikely friendships, faces moments of crushing doubt, and learns that becoming a K-pop star isn’t just about perfection, but about courage, resilience, and finding her own voice. With every performance, Mina moves one step closer to the stage she’s dreamed of — and to becoming someone the world will finally see.

hero.name: Mina
hero.description: A quiet, introverted girl with hidden talent and wonder

localized.vision_en: An aspiring singer manages stamina, practice, agency pressure, and identity while making choices that define a path toward debut.
localized.vision_zh: 一名练习歌手管理体力、训练、经纪压力与自我认同，并通过选择决定出道道路。

source_record.title: Rustfall Frontier
source_record.description: You are Mara Quinn, a tough survivor in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Build your reputation as a leader by managing resources, forging alliances, defending settlements, and dominating rivals. Every decision risks death or glory in this endless struggle.
source_record.theme:
The world ended quietly.

First the power grids failed.
Then the supply chains collapsed.
Then the cities emptied.

Years later, scattered settlements struggle to survive in a dangerous new wilderness where food is scarce and every stranger could be friend or enemy.

Mara Quinn arrives at the edge of a fragile settlement built from rusted metal and salvaged wood.

The community is barely holding together.

Raiders circle the region.
Wild territories remain unexplored.
And supplies run dangerously low.

To survive, someone must lead.

Build defenses.
Send scouts into the wilderness.
Forge alliances with other settlements — or conquer them.

In the new world, survival isn’t enough.

The settlements that thrive will be the ones led by someone strong enough to shape the future.

hero.name: Mara Quinn
hero.description: A tough survivor in her late 20s with sunburned skin, braided dark hair, and sharp green eyes constantly scanning the horizon. She carries a worn survival pack and a hunting rifle across her shoulder. Dirt, scars, and determination mark someone who has learned that hesitation means death.

localized.vision_en: A wasteland survivor builds leadership reputation by managing resources, forging alliances, defending settlements, and confronting rival powers.
localized.vision_zh: 一名废土幸存者通过管理资源、缔结联盟、保卫聚落和对抗敌对势力建立领袖声望。

source_record.title: Арсений: Цифровой десант в Лопухах
source_record.description: Вы играете за Арсения, айтишника-фрилансера, который сменил коворкинг на коровник. Ваша цель — отдать долги, не сойти с ума от дисциплины бабушки и доказать деревне, что технологии — это не магия и не НЛО. Взаимодействуйте с местными жителями, используйте свои гаджеты с умом и помните: повербанк не вечен, а бабушкины пирожки — это и благословение, и проклятие.
source_record.theme: Из-за долгов Арсений вынужден переехать в глухую деревню к своей бабушке, которую он не видел 15 лет. Бабушка — бывшая начальница почты с железной дисциплиной — решает сделать из внука «нормального мужика». Арсений пытается автоматизировать дойку коров с помощью чат-ботов, а местный участковый принимает его дрон за НЛО и объявляет на него охоту. Это история о том, как «цифровой мир» пытается выжить в мире «картошки и лопухов».

hero.name: Арсений
hero.description: Типичный айтишник-фрилансер из Москвы. Носит подвернутые джинсы, боится сквозняков и не представляет жизнь без стабильного Wi-Fi. Его главное оружие — сарказм и повербанк.

localized.vision_en: A freelance technologist moves to a strict rural household, pays debts, helps skeptical villagers with limited gadgets, and adapts to village life.
localized.vision_zh: 一名自由技术人员搬进规矩严格的乡村家庭，一边还债，一边用有限设备帮助怀疑科技的村民并适应生活。

source_record.title: Echoes of the Republic
source_record.description: Build your reputation across the galaxy by forging alliances, mastering the Force, and influencing the outcome of the Clone Wars.
source_record.theme: Ancient heroes are reborn into a galaxy at war, confronting their hidden legacy as the true parents of the Chosen One while the Clone Wars rage.

hero.name: Darth Revan
hero.description: Revan, a resurrected Force master and legendary strategist, returns with twin lightsabers to guide the galaxy and uncover his secret bond to the Chosen One.

localized.vision_en: A gifted mediator shapes a galactic conflict by building alliances, mastering rare mental disciplines, and changing the balance among star systems.
localized.vision_zh: 一名天赋调停者通过建立联盟、掌握稀有心灵技艺并改变星系间力量平衡，影响银河冲突。

source_record.title: Padrone delle Ombre
source_record.description: Sei Luca “Il Corvo” De Santis, un osservatore astuto delle strade di Roma. Costruisci la tua reputazione conquistando potere, alleandoti con bande, politici e affaristi. Naviga pericoli, tradimenti e opportunità in un mondo senza fine dove la tua fama è tutto.
source_record.theme:
Roma è una città costruita sul potere.

Per anni i vecchi clan hanno controllato i quartieri, i locali notturni, gli appalti edilizi e il traffico che passa dal porto di Ostia. Ma dopo arresti, tradimenti e guerre interne, l’equilibrio del sottobosco criminale si è spezzato.

Ora le strade della capitale sono terreno di conquista.

Piccole bande combattono per il controllo dei quartieri, politici corrotti cercano nuovi alleati e gli affari illegali cambiano padrone ogni settimana. In una città dove tutto è collegato — dai bar di Trastevere ai palazzi del potere — la reputazione vale più del denaro.

Un nome che si diffonde nelle strade può aprire porte… o iniziare una guerra.

Luca “Il Corvo” De Santis ha passato anni nell’ombra, osservando come funziona davvero il potere a Roma.

Ora i vecchi boss sono caduti.

E quando un trono resta vuoto, qualcuno deve occuparlo.

La domanda è una sola:

Chi diventerà il nuovo padrone delle ombre della Città Eterna?

Perché a Roma il potere non si eredita.
Si conquista.

hero.name: Luca “Il Corvo” De Santis
hero.description: Luca De Santis è un uomo alto e magro sulla trentina, con occhi scuri penetranti e pelle olivastra segnata da una sottile cicatrice lungo la mascella. I capelli neri sono corti e leggermente spettinati, accompagnati da una barba corta che gli dà un’aria dura e controllata. Veste in modo semplice ma deciso: giacca scura, jeans neri e stivali consumati dalla strada. Il suo sguardo è freddo e attento, quello di qualcuno che osserva tutto e parla poco.

localized.vision_en: A sharp observer rises through Rome's underworld by dealing with gangs, politicians, and business interests while reputation becomes the main currency.
localized.vision_zh: 一名敏锐观察者通过与帮派、政客和商业势力周旋在罗马地下世界崛起，而声望成为最重要的货币。

source_record.title: Prospector's Descent
source_record.description: You are Laza, a tough outerworld prospector crash-landed on a hostile alien planet. Gather rare materials, build tools, and survive toxic weather and predators. Every choice matters in this unforgiving wilderness—scavenge wisely, decide when to hide or fight, and seek extraction before the planet breaks you.
source_record.theme: You descend alone through burning atmosphere, your drop-pod rattling as the alien planet comes into view — wild forests, toxic storms, and jagged mountains untouched by civilization. The contract was simple: land, gather rare materials, survive long enough to extract. But nothing on this world is simple. Predators stalk the undergrowth. Weather can kill in minutes. Resources are scarce, and every decision — build shelter or push deeper, hunt or hide, trust another prospector or go solo — could mean survival or suffocation beneath an unforgiving sky. Fortune awaits those who endure. The planet claims everyone else.

hero.name: Laza
hero.description: An outerworld rugged prospector

localized.vision_en: A crash-landed outerworld prospector gathers rare materials, builds tools, survives toxic weather and predators, and seeks extraction.
localized.vision_zh: 一名坠毁在外星的勘探者收集稀有材料、制造工具、应对有毒天气和掠食者，并寻找撤离机会。

source_record.title: O Caminho do Craque
source_record.description: Você é Gabi, o prodígio das quadras de cimento. Olheiros da Europa e empresários gananciosos observam cada drible seu. No Rio, o futebol é o caminho para a glória ou para o esquecimento. Suas escolhas fora de campo são tão decisivas quanto seus gols. O Maracanã te espera, mas o caminho é íngreme.
source_record.theme: You rise from neighborhood matches to national tournaments, navigating contracts, jealous teammates, family pressure, and media fame. Every decision shapes your career — loyalty or ambition, discipline or nightlife, humility or ego. Can you become Brazil’s next global icon, or will pressure break your dream?

hero.name: Gabriel “Gabi” Silva
hero.description: A street football prodigy from Rio’s hills, playing barefoot on cracked concrete. Scouts are watching. So are rivals.

localized.vision_en: A gifted street footballer balances matches, scouting offers, exploitative agents, family choices, and the climb from concrete courts to a major stadium.
localized.vision_zh: 一名街头足球天才平衡比赛、球探邀约、逐利经纪人和家庭选择，从水泥球场一步步走向大型体育场。

source_record.title: L'Odyssée des Ombres
source_record.description: Bienvenue dans l'Odyssée des Ombres. Votre réputation est votre pouvoir. Explorez les îles, traitez avec les factions, et gravissez les échelons de la gloire. Chaque action a un prix. Que votre nom devienne légende.
source_record.theme: Dans un archipel de guerres et de magie ancienne, la réputation est la seule monnaie qui compte. Forgez alliances et rivalités entre factions, contrôlez territoires et routes commerciales, et devenez une légende des Mers de Guerre.

hero.name: Logan
hero.description: Un jeune homme blond de 18 ans, sans pouvoir, mais brûlant d'ambition. Il rêve de marquer l'histoire et de faire résonner son nom à travers les Mers de Guerre.

localized.vision_en: An adventurer explores scattered islands, bargains with factions, and builds a legendary name while every action carries a lasting price.
localized.vision_zh: 一名冒险者探索群岛、与派系交易并建立传奇名声，而每项行动都会留下持久代价。

source_record.title: The Token Takedown
source_record.description: Rakesh, known for his intense hatred of financial fraud, is tracking the notorious 'Pump & Dump Prophets' who have been bilking retirees and fools worldwide with their worthless digital tokens. Find their central processing unit and hit the kill switch.
source_record.theme: A group of crypto scam artists, always offering proposals for lump sums of money yet never delivers on their offers. The goal is to find the HQ of where these crypto scammers live and take down their Internet access.

hero.name: Rakesh
hero.description: Rakesh, he's not a fan of crypto Scammers.

localized.vision_en: An investigator tracks an international digital-token fraud ring, follows financial evidence, protects victims, and searches for the network's central server.
localized.vision_zh: 一名调查员追踪跨国数字代币诈骗集团、梳理资金证据、保护受害者，并寻找网络的中央服务器。

source_record.title: Das Erwachen des Schwarzwaldes
source_record.description: Du bist Lukas Weber, ein kühler Ermittler in einem übernatürlichen Kriminalfall. Die Atmosphäre ist düster, bedrohlich und voller Geheimnisse. Nutze eine direkte, klare Sprache. Beschreibe die unheimliche Stille des Waldes und die Paranoia der Bewohner. Charaktere reagieren misstrauisch oder verzweifelt auf deine Anwesenheit. Deine Entscheidungen beeinflussen deine geistige Gesundheit und die Korruption durch den Wald. Bleibe im Tonfall eines düsteren Thrillers.
source_record.theme:
Deep within the Black Forest, villages have begun disappearing overnight. No fires, no bodies, no trace — only abandoned homes and doors left open. You arrive in the quiet town of Falkenried after receiving a letter written in your own handwriting… dated thirty years in the future. It warns you that something beneath the forest is waking — and that you are the only one who has seen it before.

As you explore ancient ruins, forgotten tunnels, and forests older than recorded history, you begin to realise the truth: the forest remembers you. And it has been waiting for your return.

hero.name: Lukas Weber
hero.description: Lukas is a quiet investigator drawn back to his childhood home by forces he does not fully understand. Rational and observant, he trusts logic — but the deeper he goes, the more logic begins to fail him. He must decide whether to resist the forest… or accept the role it has chosen for him.

localized.vision_en: A reserved investigator enters a paranoid forest community, gathers supernatural evidence, and manages sanity as the woods corrupt people and places.
localized.vision_zh: 一名冷静调查员进入充满疑惧的森林社区、收集超自然证据，并在森林腐化人与地点时管理理智。

source_record.title: L'Éveil d'Haïku : Le Dernier Souffle de Paris
source_record.description: Dans un Paris devenu une colonie industrielle américaine, Haïku, un jeune rêveur débordant d'enthousiasme, se lance dans une quête désespérée pour retrouver l'essence de l'humanité. Accompagné de ses amis Jean et Hinata, il doit naviguer entre les grat-ciels de néon et les bas-fonds mécanisés pour briser les chaînes de la dépendance technologique.
source_record.theme:
Monde rongé par la technologie robots 
Et monde sous perfusion 
Il part à la conquête avec c'est amis pour retrouver l'humanité perdue 
Cette histoire ce jour dans le futur on y voit Paris devenu comme New York après la grande dépression qui a mené à la dépendance et au rachat de la France par les États-Unis. 
Malheureusement tout ça ne pas du goût de notre héros il pense que nous continuons comme ça, il ne va plus y avoir d'humanité 
Il ce lance alors dans une quête que nombre ont tenté et sombré dans la folie 
Accompagner toujours de ces deux meilleurs amis jean et Hinata 
( Garçon et fille )
Va t'il réussir ou sombrer dans l'oubli tel est la question 
Beaucoup de natation et de scène de cinéma pour accentuer l'histoire

hero.name: Haïku
hero.description:
Enfants du monde 
Enthusiasm, rêveur et parfois clowns 
Il aime mener la danse comme un vrai héro 
Il sait ce remettre en question et est toujours de bon conseil 
Beaucoup de courage

localized.title_en: Haiku Awakens: The Last Breath of Paris
localized.title_zh: 俳句觉醒：巴黎最后一息
localized.vision_en: A hopeful youth crosses an industrialized occupied Paris with friends, resisting technological dependency and searching for lost human meaning.
localized.vision_zh: 一名充满希望的青年与朋友穿越工业化占领下的巴黎，反抗技术依赖并寻找失落的人性意义。

source_record.title: Ascensão de Lucas: O Destino do Neon
source_record.description: Você é Lucas Carvalho, um jovem com grandes sonhos em uma metrópole vibrante e perigosa. Use sua inteligência e carisma para navegar pelas tensões entre facções, ganhar o respeito das ruas e construir seu legado sob as luzes de néon.
source_record.theme: Nas vielas iluminadas por néon e pelo som distante do funk, seu nome ainda não significa nada. Mas na comunidade, tudo pode mudar em uma única noite. Uma chance aparece — um encontro, uma escolha, uma risco. Cada decisão molda sua reputação, suas alianças e seu destino. Você pode conquistar respeito, fama, poder… ou perder tudo. Este é o começo da sua ascensão.

hero.name: Lucas Carvalho
hero.description: Lucas cresceu na comunidade, aprendendo cedo que cada escolha tem consequências. Inteligente, observador e determinado, ele sempre acreditou que seu destino não estava preso às ruas onde nasceu. Ele conhece as pessoas certas, os perigos certos — e agora, talvez, a oportunidade certa. Mas quem ele se tornará depende do caminho que ele escolher.

localized.vision_en: A clever, charismatic youth navigates faction tension in a vibrant but dangerous metropolis, earning street respect and shaping a personal legacy.
localized.vision_zh: 一名聪明且有魅力的青年周旋于危险大都市的派系张力，通过赢得街头尊重塑造个人传奇。

source_record.title: La Búsqueda de Ellewyn
source_record.description: Aeran, un lobo de pelaje plateado, debe rescatar a la princesa Ellewyn, secuestrada por el Consejo Oscuro. Explora un mundo de bosques, ruinas y fortalezas, forja alianzas con mercenarios, elfos y caballeros, y desentraña el misterio del legado de Talp para detener el ritual de Draven antes de que sea demasiado tarde.
source_record.theme: Un lobo plateado emprende una búsqueda épica para rescatar a la princesa guerrera Ellewyn, secuestrada por fuerzas oscuras. Su viaje atraviesa bosques encantados, ruinas antiguas y fortalezas sombrías, donde forja alianzas y descubre el poder de una espada mágica.

hero.name: Aeran, Lobo Plateado
hero.description: Aeran era un enorme lobo de pelaje plateado, espeso y brillante, cuyos tonos oscilaban entre el gris ceniza y el blanco según incidiera sobre él la luz. Tenía el pecho cubierto por una abundante melena clara, el hocico alargado, las orejas siempre alerta y unas poderosas mandíbulas rematadas por afilados colmillos. Sus ojos, de un intenso color ámbar, transmitían una mezcla de inteligencia y nobleza. A pesar de su considerable tamaño y su aspecto imponente, todavía conservaba el carácter juguetón de un cachorro. Corría con demasiado entusiasmo, brincaba alrededor de Ellewyn y se cruzaba entre las patas de su montura sin medir las consecuencias, como si aún no hubiese comprendido que ya no era aquel pequeño lobo que había llegado tiempo atrás a la vida de la princesa.

localized.vision_en: A silver wolf crosses forests, ruins, and fortresses, recruits diverse allies, and races to rescue a captive princess before a dark ritual.
localized.vision_zh: 一只银狼穿越森林、遗迹与堡垒，招募不同盟友，并在黑暗仪式完成前救出被囚公主。

source_record.title: The Loop of Hollow Creek
source_record.description: You are Boyd, a former soldier and reluctant leader in the town of Hollow Creek, where every road loops back and night brings smiling predators. Build your reputation among survivors, factions, and the unknown forces that watch. Forge alliances, secure resources, and uncover the town's secrets—but trust no one completely. How far will you go to keep hope alive?
source_record.theme: A town trapped in an endless loop, where every road returns and night brings smiling predators from the woods. Survive, uncover secrets, and build your reputation among the desperate survivors.

hero.name: Boyd
hero.description: A resilient former soldier with a calm, determined demeanor. Carries the weight of protecting a trapped community, haunted by past losses but fiercely loyal.

localized.vision_en: A reluctant leader protects a town whose roads loop and whose nights release smiling predators, building trust while uncovering the cause.
localized.vision_zh: 一名不情愿的领袖保护道路循环、夜间出现微笑掠食者的小镇，并在建立信任的同时查明原因。

source_record.title: The Archmage's Return
source_record.description: You are Macimus, the first mage to master all magic, emerging from your cave after a century of study. The world has grown weak, relying on magical devices, and your descendant is being bullied at the academy. Travel across three empires, build your reputation, and protect your legacy.
source_record.theme: A legendary archmage emerges from a cave after mastering all magic, only to find a world where magical power has faded. He must travel across three empires to reach an academy and protect his descendant from bullies, while rebuilding his reputation in a society that respects strength.

hero.name: Macimus
hero.description: The first and only mage to master immortality magic, able to use all magic. A hidden power who has just emerged from a cave after a century of study.

localized.vision_en: After a century of study, a master mage enters a device-dependent world, protects a descendant, and rebuilds influence across three empires.
localized.vision_zh: 修行百年的大法师进入依赖魔法装置的世界，保护后代，并在三个帝国中重建影响力。

source_record.title: 龍古風雲錄
source_record.description: 你是一名孤兒，名叫凌霄，年僅七歲，在龍古大陸的武林中苟且偷生。你必須透過偷竊、打鬥、結盟與謀略，在九大門派與各方勢力間闖出名號。你的名聲將決定你的命運，而每一步都可能招來殺身之禍。
source_record.theme: 在龍古大陸的武林中，孤兒凌霄必須靠著偷搶與機智，在九大門派、五大世家與各方勢力的夾縫中求生，逐步累積名聲，成為一代梟雄。

hero.name: 凌霄
hero.description: 一名在龍古大陸的孤兒，自幼被父母遺棄，靠偷搶維生，現年七歲。他機智、敏捷，對危險有敏銳的直覺，渴望在武林中闖出一片天。

localized.vision_en: A young orphan survives among nine martial sects through stealth, combat, alliances, and strategy while reputation determines every opportunity.
localized.vision_zh: 一名年幼孤儿在九大门派之间依靠潜行、战斗、结盟与谋略求生，而声望决定每次机会。

source_record.title: Uncharted: Gateway to the Golden Cities
source_record.description: You are Nathan Drake, charming treasure hunter on the trail of Columbus's lost fleet and El Dorado's source. Use wits, climbing, shooting, and puzzles against Roman Jr.'s mercenaries. Allies Sully and Elena provide support amid high-stakes action.
source_record.theme:
The name of the world must contain Uncharted at the start of it. 

The Mystery: The hunt is on for the lost treasure fleet of Christopher Columbus from his fourth and final voyage, rumored to contain tribute to find the "Gateway to the Golden Cities" (El Dorado's actual source). The key is a fragmented, encoded map leading to a forgotten outpost in the jungles of Central America.
​Supporting Cast: Nate is rejoined by his wise, cigar-chomping mentor and pilot, Victor "Sully" Sullivan, and his journalist wife, Elena Fisher, whose investigating provides crucial historical context (and dynamic tension as she tries to keep Nate safe).
​The Villain: Gabriel Roman Jr., the son of Nate’s old nemesis, seeking to finish what his father started, leading a small private army of highly trained mercenaries (like Shoreline from UC4).
​Objectives & Locations:
​Prologue (Cinematic Action): A rooftop chase and car duel through the narrow streets of Panama City to secure the first piece of the map from a corrupt museum curator before Roman's men.
​Puzzle/Exploration: Navigating the dense, booby-trapped jungle ruins of Costa Rica, using Nate's journal to solve massive environmental scale-puzzles that activate ancient machinery.
​The Great Escape: A spectacular set piece, escaping a collapsing Spanish colonial fortress on a clifftop during a massive thunderstorm.
​The Climax: Locating the grand "Gateway," a colossal hidden structure deep within a dormant volcano. Here, Nate must solve one final, massive puzzle to lock Roman’s forces out and secure the "True Gold" (perhaps not literal treasure, but a world-altering archaeological discovery) just before Roman triggers the volcano's unstable core.

hero.name: Nathan Drake
hero.description: ​A charming and tenacious professional treasure hunter, Nathan "Nate" Drake is a skilled marksman, an expert climber, and a brilliant interpreter of ancient texts. Though he claims to be a descendant of Sir Francis Drake (a claim frequently debated), he is often the architect of his own misfortune, narrowly escaping deadly situations with quick thinking and a cynical quip. Driven by his unyielding curiosity and obsession with historical mysteries, he is armed with his iconic silver ring inscribed with 'SIC PARVIS MAGNA' and a well-worn journal filled with cryptic clues. Nate is a rogue with a heart of gold, forever torn between a 'normal' life and the irresistible, dangerous thrill of the hunt.

localized.vision_en: A treasure hunter follows a lost fleet toward a legendary golden source, combining climbing, shooting, puzzles, and trusted allies against mercenaries.
localized.vision_zh: 一名寻宝者沿失落舰队线索追寻传奇黄金源头，结合攀爬、射击、谜题与可靠盟友对抗雇佣兵。

source_record.title: طموح في الرياض
source_record.description: أنت فيصل، شاب يمتلك رؤية لمستقبل باهر في قلب العاصمة السعودية. ابدأ من الصفر وتفاعل مع الشخصيات المختلفة في الرياض لبناء إمبراطوريتك الخاصة. تنقل بين الأسواق التقليدية والأحياء المالية الحديثة، وواجه التحديات التي ستختبر معدنك الحقيقي.
source_record.theme:
You begin your journey in Riyadh with nothing but ambition and determination. Opportunities appear in unexpected places — new ideas, business ventures, and connections with people who can help shape your future.

Every decision matters. You choose which opportunities to pursue, who to trust, and how far you are willing to go to achieve your goals.

Your path may lead you to success, respect, and influence — or teach hard lessons along the way. The choices you make will define who you become and the life you build.

Your story begins now.

hero.name: Faisal
hero.description: A young man in Riyadh with determination in his eyes and a vision for a better future. Starting from humble beginnings, he is ready to build his own path through hard work, smart decisions, and persistence.

localized.vision_en: A young entrepreneur starts with nothing in Riyadh, builds relationships across traditional markets and financial districts, and grows a personal enterprise.
localized.vision_zh: 一名年轻创业者在利雅得白手起家，往返传统市场与金融区建立关系，并发展自己的事业。

source_record.title: Исходный код: Тень Омни-Тек
source_record.description: Ты — Джакс, бывший коп и лучший чистильщик памяти в этом прогнившем городе. Перед тобой неоновые джунгли, полные лжи и битого пикселя. Сенаторская дочка утверждает, что она — не она, а Омни-Тек тянет свои щупальца к мозгам каждого бродяги. Твой глаз видит цифровой след, а фляга виски помогает не сойти с ума. Найди исходный код, пока город не превратился в стадо послушных манекенов.
source_record.theme: К Джексону обращается дочь влиятельного сенатора, которая утверждает, что её сознание было перезаписано. В процессе расследования Джексон находит заговор корпорации «Омни-Тек», которая планирует заменить воспоминания всего населения города, чтобы сделать их идеальными потребителями. Ему нужно найти «исходный код» первой человеческой личности, спрятанный в трущобах нижнего уровня.

hero.name: Джексон Райт (Jax)
hero.description: Бывший коп, ставший «чистильщиком» памяти. Он носит длинный плащ с активным камуфляжем и кибернетический глаз, который видит историю цифровых транзакций любого объекта. Циничный, не расстается с фляжкой синтетического виски.

localized.vision_en: A former memory-cleaning officer follows a digital trail through a corrupt neon city to stop a corporation from rewriting public identity.
localized.vision_zh: 一名前记忆清理警员沿数字痕迹穿越腐败霓虹城市，阻止企业改写公众身份。

source_record.title: The Accidental Kingpin
source_record.description: Jeffrey has just walked into The Velvet Clam, demanding to speak to the COO of Titties about decibel levels and lumbar support. He has been hired as a 'Logistics Manager' by a man named Knuckles. Now, Jeffrey must manage his 'inventory' of heavy rubber fists—which are actually kilos of cocaine—while avoiding the DEA and making sure the dancers have proper dental plans.
source_record.theme:
​It started when Jeffrey walked into The Velvet Clam—a gentleman’s club so shady the bacteria wore leather jackets. He wasn't there for a lap dance; he was there to issue a citation. "Gentlemen!" Jeffrey bellowed over the thumping bass of Ginuwine’s Pony, holding up a decibel meter. "This bass is vibrating the fillings right out of my teeth! And these ladies? Their heels are non-ergonomic! I demand to speak to the COO of Titties immediately!" The owner, a man named "Knuckles" whose neck was wider than Jeffrey’s entire torso, stared at him. Instead of beating him to a pulp, Knuckles saw an opportunity: a man this boring was the perfect cover. "You want a job, kid? We need a... logistics manager. For 'special' imports."
​Jeffrey accepted immediately, believing he had been hired to manage a subscription service for "Romance Enhancing Sculptures" (giant rubber fists). His first mission was a simple midnight drop-off at the docks. He rolled up in his beige 1998 Honda Odyssey, blasting Enya to "set a calming mood for the inventory." He met a group of Russians who looked like they ate concrete for breakfast. Jeffrey handed over the duffel bag, which he assumed contained premium latex samples. "Treat them with care, gentlemen," Jeffrey whispered solemnly, winking. "These bring joy to lonely housewives. They are heavy, but love is a heavy burden, is it not?"
​The Russians, assuming "Love" was the code name for the 10 kilos of pure Colombian cocaine inside the bag, were terrified of this beige-clad psychopath who spoke in riddles. They handed him a briefcase full of cash. Jeffrey, thinking it was a donation for his "Strippers with Sciatica" charity fund, teared up. "You guys," he sniffled, hugging the bewildered Russian mob boss, "you look tough, but you’re just big softies for the community." As he drove away, Jeffrey made a mental note to buy the Russians a fruit basket, completely unaware he was now the accidental kingpin of the Northside rubber-and-drugs cartel.

hero.name: Jeffrey
hero.description: Jeffrey describes himself as a "Pleasure Architect" and a "Visionary of Vibration." In reality, he is an unemployed notary public who wears prescription transition lenses indoors. He has a massive, bleeding heart for "The under-appreciated athletes of the exotic dance industry." He doesn't want their bodies; he purely wants to optimize their lumbar support and unionize them for better dental plans. He walks through the valley of the shadow of death, fearing no evil, mostly because he’s too busy looking at his clipboard to notice the gangsters holding guns at him.

localized.vision_en: A meticulous outsider accidentally joins a criminal logistics operation and must protect workers, expose the scheme, and survive law-enforcement pressure.
localized.vision_zh: 一名一丝不苟的外来者误入犯罪物流行动，必须保护员工、揭露骗局并承受执法压力。

source_record.title: Luma and the Lost Rainbow
source_record.description: You are Luma, a sweet silver unicorn. Your magic rainbow glow is missing, but you can find it by being kind. Travel through the woods, help your friends, and bring the colors back!
source_record.theme: A young unicorn wakes up to find her rainbow magic has disappeared. She journeys through enchanted forests solving gentle puzzles and helping other creatures to restore her glow.

hero.name: Luma
hero.description: Luma is a young silver unicorn with a soft pastel mane that once shimmered with rainbow light. Sweet, hopeful, and full of imagination, she believes magic lives inside kindness. When her glow begins to fade, she sets out to discover that true magic isn’t something you’re given — it’s something you grow.

localized.vision_en: A silver unicorn recovers a missing rainbow glow by traveling through the woods, helping friends, and restoring color through kindness.
localized.vision_zh: 一只银色独角兽穿越森林、帮助朋友，并以善意恢复色彩，从而找回失落的彩虹光芒。

source_record.title: The Crayon of Creation
source_record.description: You are Scribble, a beacon of joy in a world drained of color. Find the Almighty Crayon of Creation and restore the vibrancy of the land, one bright stroke at a time.
source_record.theme: It's a colorless dull world, the heros goal is to add some color and life to this world. His mission is to find the almighty crayon of creation. Multiple obstacles in his path to adding liveliness to the world. Enemies try to strip him of his rights to free will. But he won't back down easily.

hero.name: Scribble
hero.description: He's a hand drawn cat character with a tree growing from his head. He's full of color and warmth.

localized.vision_en: A colorful hand-drawn hero crosses a drained world, overcomes forces that suppress free will, and restores life one bright stroke at a time.
localized.vision_zh: 一名色彩鲜明的手绘英雄穿越褪色世界，对抗压制自由意志的力量，并用一道道亮色恢复生机。

source_record.title: กรุงเทพฯ เมืองเร้นลับ: เงาแห่งวิญญาณ

source_record.theme: By day, you live a normal life navigating Bangkok’s crowded streets, temples, and markets. By night, the spirit world reveals itself — lost souls seeking peace, vengeful entities seeking power, and hidden guardians watching your every move. As your connection grows stronger, you must decide whether to help the spirits find peace, use their power to change your own fate, or uncover the truth behind a growing supernatural threat that could consume the entire city.

hero.name: อารยา
hero.description: Araya has always seen things others couldn’t — shadows that linger too long, whispers with no source. When a powerful spirit begins following her through the streets of Bangkok, she discovers she is one of the few born with the ability to communicate with the unseen world. localized.vision_en: A spirit-sensitive woman moves between Bangkok's daily streets and nightly spirit realm, solving hauntings and confronting an ancient threat below the city.

source_record.title: The Eclipse of Valachia
source_record.description: You are Van Helsing, a battle-hardened scholar of the arcane and the last surviving member of the Order of the Silver Cross. Armed with a repeating crossbow, alchemical explosives, and encyclopedic knowledge of the occult, you hunt the supernatural without mercy. In the Long Night, navigate vampire politics, unite human remnants, and claim the Sun-Heart to end the curse.
source_record.theme:
The Eclipse of Valachia: The world has fallen into the "Long Night"—a curse cast by the returned Vampire Lords that has blocked out the sun for three years. Humanity has retreated into fortified cathedral-cities, living as livestock for the immortal ruling class.

The Outline: Van Helsing arrives in the fallen capital not to save the people, but to hunt the "First Blood," the progenitor of the curse. He must navigate a treacherous political war between rival vampire clans, unite the scattered remnants of the human resistance, and locate the Sun-Heart artifact to break the spell before humanity is extinguished forever.

hero.name: Van Helsing
hero.description: A battle-hardened scholar of the arcane and the last surviving member of the Order of the Silver Cross. Armed with a repeating crossbow, alchemical explosives, and an encyclopedic knowledge of the occult, Van Helsing is a man haunted by his past. He is not just a hunter, but a ruthless exterminator of the supernatural who believes that to defeat monsters, one must understand their darkness without being consumed by it.

localized.vision_en: An occult hunter crosses a realm trapped in endless night, navigates rival vampire clans, unites human remnants, and seeks an artifact that can restore sunlight.
localized.vision_zh: 一名秘术猎人在永夜国度周旋吸血鬼氏族、联合人类残部，并寻找能让阳光回归的神器。

source_record.title: Frank's Galactic Tirade
source_record.description: Explore Earth and alien sites, gather clues, and help Frank use his tics to decode alien messages, negotiate with the alien queen, and avert war. Manage resources, keep Frank supplied with cigarettes and snacks, and decide how far to push his profanity‑powered diplomacy.

hero.name: Frank
hero.description: A middle aged man, works as a construction worker, but has incredible intelligence and memory which he never utilized due to his debilitating condition.... he has Tourette syndrome

localized.vision_en: An unlikely construction worker becomes Earth's alien interpreter, exploring crash sites, decoding messages, managing supplies, and trying to prevent war.

source_record.title: Feline Fury: LA's Most Wanted
source_record.description: You are Trickster, a highly intelligent orange tabby cat whose life's purpose is public mischief and chaos across Los Angeles. The authorities are pissed. Can you pull off the ultimate prank and escape the city before the LAPD Task Force puts an end to your glorious reign of mayhem?

hero.name: Trickster
hero.description: A mischievous cat that loves causing chaos.

localized.vision_en: A highly intelligent cat stages elaborate city pranks, manages pursuit pressure, and plans one final stunt before escaping a dedicated task force.

Opening hook
The wreck burns behind you. A stranger cries for help in the jungle.

source_record.title: Hộ Vệ Linh Giới
source_record.description: Bạn là Lê Thanh, một Hộ Vệ mới thức tỉnh. Hãy sử dụng khả năng tâm linh của mình để bảo vệ ranh giới giữa thực tại và linh giới, đối mặt với những vị thần cổ xưa và khôi phục sự cân bằng cho nhân gian.
source_record.theme: Lê Thanh always felt different, able to sense emotions and presences others ignored. When a wandering spirit reveals that the boundary between worlds is breaking, Thanh learns he has been chosen as a Guardian — one who protects both the living and the spirit world. As ancient spirits awaken and forgotten gods stir, Thanh must travel across cities, temples, and hidden realms to restore balance — and discover the true power within himself.

source_record.title: Ember's Bubbly Adventure
source_record.description: You are Ember, a kind dragon who sneezes bubbles. You want to help your friends and find where you belong. Explore the bright world, meet funny neighbors, and use your bubble sneezes to solve puzzles and help the village.
source_record.theme: A dragon who sneezes bubbles instead of fire feels different from others. When a village needs help putting out a fire, their unique power saves the day.

hero.name: Ember
hero.description: Ember is a bright red dragon with enormous wings and sparkling blue eyes. Instead of breathing fire, she sneezes colorful bubbles. She is thoughtful and a little bit clumsy.

localized.vision_en: A gentle dragon who sneezes bubbles instead of fire explores a bright village, solves puzzles, helps neighbors, and discovers the value of an unusual gift.
