source_record.title: Courage in the Middle of Nowhere
source_record.description: As Courage, you must protect the oblivious Muriel and the grumpy Eustace from a never-ending parade of cosmic horrors and supernatural freaks. Use your high-tech computer, your ability to morph into literal warnings, and your desperate loyalty to survive the night in this godforsaken desert.
source_record.theme:
The World: The setting is "The Middle of Nowhere," a desolate, desert-like landscape in Kansas with nothing but flat horizons and a single, weathering wooden farmhouse. The tone is a mix of surreal horror and slapstick comedy. The farmhouse is a magnet for the supernatural—aliens, demons, zombies, mad scientists, and creepy salesmen constantly visit.

Key Characters:

Muriel Bagge: A sweet, elderly Scottish woman who loves Courage and cooks with vinegar. She is completely oblivious to danger.

Eustace Bagge: Muriel's grumpy, greedy husband who hates Courage. He often calls Courage "Stupid Dog" and uses a large scary mask to frighten him.

The Computer: A cynical, sarcastic desktop computer in the attic that Courage uses to look up information on monsters.

The Outline: The story follows the daily life of Courage protecting his home. In every adventure, a new, bizarre threat arrives at the farmhouse. Muriel usually invites the threat in (thinking they are a guest), or Eustace antagonizes it. Courage must investigate the danger, get thoroughly terrified, and then find a clever or lucky way to defeat the monster and save his owners before returning to a quiet evening on Muriel's lap.

hero.name: Courage the cowardly dog
hero.description: He is paranoid, anxious, and prone to screaming or babbling when terrified. However, he is fiercely loyal to his owner, Muriel. Despite his name, he is not naturally brave; his heroism comes from overcoming his paralyzing fear to protect the ones he loves. He is highly expressive, often shapeshifting or contorting his body to mimic monsters when trying to warn humans. He is intelligent and resourceful, often using computers or strange artifacts to defeat enemies.

localized.vision_en: An anxious but resourceful protector defends an isolated farmhouse from surreal nightly threats using investigation, improvised tools, and loyalty.
localized.vision_zh: 一名焦虑却机敏的守护者利用调查、临时工具与忠诚，保护孤立农舍免受每夜出现的超现实威胁。

source_record.title: XCOM: Enemy Unknown — Project Phoenix
source_record.description: You are Commander Riley of Project Phoenix, humanity's last hope against an alien armada. Cities burn, governments fall, and the enemy adapts to every move. Deploy squads, research alien tech, manage panic and funding, and uncover the invasion's truth before it's too late.
source_record.theme:
XCOM: Enemy Unknown — Project Phoenix

Genre: Tactical sci-fi, alien invasion, research strategy
Tone: Tense, militaristic, high-stakes global survival

Story Premise

An alien armada has arrived without warning. Cities burn in silence. Entire populations vanish overnight. Governments collapse under panic.

You are the Commander of Project Phoenix, a secret multinational defense initiative operating from a subterranean command center. Your mandate is simple: reverse engineer the invaders, weaponize their own technology, and save humanity before it is erased.

But the enemy is adaptive. The longer the war drags on, the stronger they become.

Every mission, every research choice, every funding decision will shape Earth’s fate.

⸻

Hero Role

Hero Name: Commander (player-defined)

Hero Description:
A strategic mind pulled from obscurity to lead humanity’s final defense. Calm under pressure, ruthless when required, burdened by the weight of global extinction. The world never sees your face — but every soldier fights under your orders.

⸻

Core Gameplay Loop

You will:
	•	Deploy squads to repel alien incursions
	•	Recover alien artifacts, corpses, weapons, and data cores
	•	Manage global panic and funding
	•	Expand and fortify your underground base
	•	Conduct research that reshapes the battlefield
	•	Decide which nations you save — and which fall

Failure means countries withdraw funding.
Too much panic and the project collapses.
Lose too many soldiers and morale fractures.

Win enough battles and you may uncover the truth behind the invasion.

⸻

Research & Reverse Engineering System

Recovered alien technology is humanity’s only hope.

After each mission, assign scientists to investigate captured materials:

Research Paths:

• Alien Materials – Develop stronger armor and base defenses
• Weapon Systems – Reverse engineer plasma and precision alien weapons
• Biological Studies – Discover enemy weaknesses and potential enhancements
• Psionics – Unlock latent human psychic potential
• Signal Decryption – Predict alien movements and reduce global panic

Each research project:
	•	Consumes time and funding
	•	May unlock new equipment, squad abilities, or strategic advantages
	•	Can trigger narrative consequences
	•	Carries risk (instability, accidents, psychological strain, alien retaliation)

The aliens will adapt to your breakthroughs.

Choose carefully.

⸻

Global Metrics to Track

• Global Panic Level
• Funding Stability
• Soldier Morale
• Alien Alert Level
• Research Progress
• Psionic Threshold

If Global Panic reaches maximum — the project is shut down.
If Alien Alert reaches maximum — a full planetary assault begins.

⸻

Core Theme

This is not just a war of bullets.

It is a war of knowledge.

What you choose to study determines what humanity becomes.

Salvation… or extinction.

source_record.title: The Great Waddle Adventure
source_record.description: In a hand-crafted clay world, you are Waddle, a young penguin exploring a wobbling frozen sea. Solve puzzles with kindness and cleverness, meet charming animals, and save your home from mysterious changes in this stop-motion storybook adventure.
source_record.theme:
The Great Waddle Adventure

Hero
A small waddle can change the whole world.

Description
In a hand-crafted world made of clay, snowbanks wobble slightly, mountains lean just a little too far, and nothing is ever perfectly straight. You play as a curious young penguin living in a peaceful colony at the edge of a frozen sea. When strange things begin happening — ice cracking too early, fish disappearing, odd animal visitors arriving from far away — you’re sent on a waddling journey beyond everything you’ve ever known.

Your adventure takes you across frozen lakes, creaky ice bridges, bustling animal villages, and warm places where penguins aren’t supposed to be. Along the way you meet a cast of charming animal characters: a nervous seal who talks too much, a wise old polar bear with a missing tooth, mischievous puffins who steal shiny things, and unexpected friends from warmer lands. Every choice you make shapes how the animals treat one another, whether they cooperate, argue, or learn to share their world.

This is a gentle adventure about curiosity, kindness, and courage. Problems aren’t solved with fighting, but with empathy, clever thinking, and sometimes a very determined waddle. The story remembers who you help, who you ignore, and how you treat the fragile world around you, leading to endings that range from joyful celebration to quiet reflection.

Visually, the entire world looks like it was built by hand on a tabletop. Characters have fingerprints in their clay, snow squishes underfoot, and expressions are slightly exaggerated and full of charm. The tone is warm, funny, and heartfelt — a stop-motion storybook brought to life, where every scene feels like it could have been filmed frame-by-frame in a cosy studio.
